The bottom line is that opponents of voting rights could easily enact many of the proposed policies from Project 2025. We're focused on the changes to voting and our elections, but there's no doubt that this plan would radically alter our country and our lives into a mix of our inequitable past and an unrecognizable autocracy. The loss of rights might well be irreversible.
We cannot stand by and let Project 2025 become reality. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every voter knows about the dangerous consequences of this plan before they vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101424_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101424_3&amount=25]

There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Already heard enough and are willing to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101424_3&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and educate voters about these dangerous plans with $25 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101424_3&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Hey there.
I just got off the debate stage from the final debate in my U.S. Senate race and wanted to send you a quick note asking for your help.
Over the last week, I have had two opportunities to speak directly to voters on TV about why I am running to represent them in the U.S. Senate and all the ways my vision differs from my opponent.
For the second time in as many weeks, we saw Mike Rogers run away from his record on reproductive freedom, on protecting Social Security and Medicare, and we even heard him support Betsy DeVos, who has backed his campaign as a donor and has worked tirelessly to destroy public schools.
These debates have been key moments in our campaign – but we still have a whole LOT of groundwork to cover in these final 22 days. Debates alone don't win elections.
Winning takes a team.
And the most important thing we need right now to ensure victory is the resources to reach the undecided and persuadable voters who may not have been watching tonight – that happens by keeping our ads on TV and digital platforms through Election Day, sending out a couple final rounds of mail, and doubling down on our robust ground game in these final weeks.
[**So if holding this Senate seat and making sure Democrats win in Michigan this November is important to you, I am asking you to make a contribution to my campaign today.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241014-4-900&t=2&akid=2068%2E135344%2E5n2Plh)

| | | | | **Heinrich’s 20-year report card features straight F’s**
### _Nella Domenici delivers strong case for firing Martin Heinrich_
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=be82ffd8b0&e=780129cd82)
| **Albuquerque, NM -** Today, Nella Domenici showed why [New Mexicans are ready to fire Senator Martin Heinrich](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=0ac4b69563&e=780129cd82) and bring a New Day for New Mexico.
**“Martin Heinrich has been in public office for twenty years and all he has to show for it is a report card full of F’s,”** said Domenici Campaign Manager Noah Jennings. **“Across the board, on critical issues like border security, crime, education, and the cost-of-living, Martin Heinrich is too radical for New Mexico, and we look forward to highlighting his failures once again on the debate stage later this month.”**
Martin Heinrich admitted his record for New Mexico is “crystal clear” and that is true. New Mexico under Heinrich: \- **46th** for cost of living \- **1st** for highest crime rate \- **45th** on the economy \- **LAST** in education
New Mexicans deserve better than Heinrich’s disaster performance for our state, and Nella Domenici clearly laid out that case today.
When asked about the Biden Administration’s failures to secure our nation’s southern border, Heinrich said, “I support everything the Biden Administration has done...” Indeed, Heinrich’s open border policies have driven the Fentanyl epidemic that has taken over New Mexico’s neighborhoods and fueled our state’s crime problem.
Domenici made clear that Martin Heinrich helped drive the sky-high cost of living that New Mexicans are grappling with everyday through reckless federal spending.
On education, Heinrich has been completely absent while New Mexico students continue to underperform in reading, math, and even in school attendance.
Pointing out his misplaced priorities, she said, “He brings in electric buses, but kids aren’t even going to school.”
Martin Heinrich is too radical for New Mexico and he showed that on the stage today.

body:
The last chance we’ve got to show strength to our opponents. And we’re in a really, really precarious position.
#

Peter -
Our pre-general FEC fundraising deadline is coming up on Wednesday. The last chance we’ve got to show strength to our opponents.
And we’re in a really, really precarious position.
With this final public filing deadline of the campaign looming, we’ve been raising less than half what we hoped we would. If something doesn’t change, we’re not just in danger of missing our goals... We’d give a big signal to everyone that this race is vulnerable. That could invite a LOT of trouble.
Now the way we see it, we have two ways to catch up:
1. We either need more people to chip in before our final pre-general FEC deadline in two days.
2. Or we need everyone who donates to give just a little bit more than usual.

Our average donation is around $30, but most first-time contributors chip in anywhere from $5 to $10. If you would consider making your first contribution $15 instead, it’ll help us make up for lost ground. What do you say?
[**Can you make a $15 donation to help Ruben make some progress on our pre-general FEC fundraising goal before it hits in two days? This is so important. We can’t do this without you.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241014-5-160&t=1&akid=3356%2E734936%2EdIqDpD)

Or... if that’s not the right amount for you, chip in whatever you can here:
[DONATE ANYTHING YOU CAN](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241014-5-160&t=3&akid=3356%2E734936%2EdIqDpD)
Kari Lake is leaning heavily on MAGA Right billionaires to fund her campaign and run the advertising she needs to take us down. From Elon Musk all the way down, it’s big checks and pallets of cash that she’s counting on.
Not us. Emails like this to supporters like you are the single biggest source of donations we have had throughout this campaign.
So, when Ruben wins in November, we hope you know that you played a big part.
Thanks a lot,
Team Gallego

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Knocking doors in Beloit and Kenosha, Young Republicans event in Oak Creek, Friday Night Lights at Elkhorn, and meeting with the Whitewater CR's. | | | | |
---
| 22 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
---
| **Knocking Doors in Beloit** I was back in Beloit knocking doors, and listening to Wisconsin voters about the challenges we face.
---
[Click Here to Watch Coverage of Our Day In Beloit]()
| We have to get our country back on track. But if we want to win, we need to continue talking to voters about the issues that matter to them.
---
| | | | | **Door Knocking in Kenosha** I joined our grassroots volunteers in Kenosha this weekend before they went out to knock doors. It’s crucial that we bring our message directly to voters in every community.
---
| We have a big opportunity to keep moving Kenosha towards the right, and our volunteers are working hard everyday to make that a reality. I’m thankful for their hard work!
---
| **National Young Republican Deployment in Oak Creek** We a had a great crew of Young Republicans from across the country out door knocking for us in Oak Creek this weekend. We had a great showing!
---
| We need to get the vote out for every Republican on the ballot. In Milwaukee County, we need to make sure we get Jessie Rodriguez and Bob Donovan across the line in their State Assembly races!
---
| | | | | **Friday Night Lights** Westosha Central vs. Elkhorn was the game of the week in southeastern Wisconsin. It was great to see so many familiar faces.
---
| It was Elkhorn’s homecoming week and they came out on top. Only one more week until playoffs!
---
| **Whitewater College Republicans** I spent an evening with UW-Whitewater College Republicans to talk about the state of the race and the issues that are impacting young people.
---
| I appreciate their hard work spreading our message on campus!
---
| **Join Me for Breakfast in Beloit** We’re under 30 days until Election Day. But Democrats are sparing no expense. So far, they've spent $4 million attacking me on Milwaukee TV.
We’re fighting back with ads of our own, **but we need your help**.
If you’re able and willing, I’d like to invite you to a morning reception on October 17 in Beloit. The event will begin at 8:00 a.m. and location will be provided upon RSVP.
If you plan on attending, please RSVP to **tripp@steilforwisconsin.com**.
---
| I’m grateful for your support.
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
---
| | | | [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/f32eeae42e6c/campaign-update?e=e907534017)
Steil for Wisconsin, Inc. * 1818 Milton Ave # 1448 * Janesville, WI 53545-1129 * USA

| | | | |
# We Can’t Let Bigotry & Hate Win!

As a proud Muslim American, I cherish the religious freedom that is a founding principle of our nation. America has allowed me to live a life of opportunity and service to others, alongside countless millions—Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jews, Hindus, and others—who have sought refuge here, fleeing persecution and discrimination. I often quote my good friend, **California Governor Gavin Newsom** : "_**We don’t tolerate diversity; we celebrate it, because it is the backbone of democracy and what makes America so great."**_ This celebration of diversity is what sets us apart, and it's why we must reject leaders who promote hate and division.
The election is just three weeks away, and polls show an incredibly close race that could come down to a few thousand votes in a handful of states. Every vote matters. Now, more than ever, we must do whatever we can to reach out to our family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues to make sure they are informed about Donald Trump’s racist views and destructive policies. We need to ensure they’re ready to vote for Kamala Harris and Democrats on November 5th, to protect the values that make our country strong.
If you're able to give, please click the link below to help the campaign finish strong and prevent another four years of Trump in the White House.Please share this video with your network and help spread the truth. Together, we can make a difference.
Sincerely,
Asif

The GOP has made its agenda of chaos and destruction well-known to the American people. We know exactly what they stand for:

**\- A national abortion ban.** They want to ensure women lose the right to have control over their own bodies.
**\- Cuts to Social Security and Medicare.** Our social safety net is vital to not just our seniors, but all Americans in need. They rely on these benefits to pay for their food, clothing, healthcare, and more – but Republicans want to slash benefits without regard to the effect it will have on recipients.
**\- The elimination of the Department of Education.** Our children’s education is so important, yet Republicans want to eliminate vital programs designed to keep kids on track. We cannot allow education to become a political game.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7vbkkihhbn5s4tta57e6jq03qqft1bi1p9q8i28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjgecpr4cdh2bs) [NO](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3um8c8g6fcejg80ern1pf25u0ado4nia6k07i30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjgecpr4cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zog8oln0qo479vtohp5mvf3891rdhi26g99fhr48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjgecpr4cdh2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Indigenous Peoples Day was first officially celebrated three years ago, and was commemorated to support awareness about the history, needs, [contributions](https://substack.com/redirect/42db88a0-7c54-4bd7-a8f4-dfec321d3042?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and continuing challenges of indigenous communities. Yet, as the world stands by watching a genocide unfold targeting the indigenous peoples of Palestine, editors of U.S. news organizations found better things to cover, like [opinions and predictions](https://substack.com/redirect/1983b710-2bed-4e24-ae41-4da7617cf843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the upcoming election shared by a former president whose legacy includes the corporate co-optation of the Democratic Party.
To their credit, outlets including [USA Today](https://substack.com/redirect/ff290b0c-3cae-4e2e-843b-c50313c00a29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [NPR](https://substack.com/redirect/7b11a2c0-1b0d-4ed3-a8d2-fdbbb0b43341?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) covered Indigenous Peoples Day, while conveniently omitting any reference to how the day relates to other headlines about, for instance, Israel's [latest attack on civilian targets](https://substack.com/redirect/eb6a9e8e-578d-489b-afc7-5b9166f0612b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8456593-df1f-46ef-9f3f-90d73d92a8b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
An Indigenous Peoples Day celebration at Yerba Buena Gardens in San Francisco
Gaza is not the only part of the world where indigenous people are under attack today. Across the Amazon, [illegal loggers are encroaching](https://substack.com/redirect/7b8eeac9-78ac-49e2-9174-af77ce40b670?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the territory of indigenous peoples in the service of industries including ranching and mining, often driving [armed conflict](https://substack.com/redirect/a758d0b8-9a0c-48be-8931-d29e4f9402bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). One of my next posts will review an important documentary film depicting indigenous resistance to this illegal logging in Brazil.
Of course, the United States has an [especially shameful history](https://substack.com/redirect/79083c44-940a-48f8-a76a-e9ae890f7684?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of indigenous genocide. ## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zbpt0ba97nkgm7hi1561kphe4euf0hlrm66jv4mg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjge6ob6cph2bs) [NO](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zeqqtp6lttrdkbulio45bcsgh6dgkf9e2fe1ta90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjge6ob6cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6vtj9t5ssb6nk1q7ieej1g8h4hqqet9l52dfppg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjge6ob6cph2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za1m7ckh8jip2jgh9mfvt8si8mb7jh7r5mj4fr4o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjie0o34c5h2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbp05kikn237ma3g6u4h3b0vanhlte5m09l0fdbg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sjie0o34c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County GOP News (Oct 15, 2024)
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

We hope to see many of you at our monthly meeting tonight, Tuesday, October 15 at 6:00 PM at Calvary United Baptist Church at 9480 County Rd 25A, Sidney, Oh 45365.

Today marks **three** weeks until Presidential Election Day 2024 so we want to share **three** requests with you today:

#1 please come meet Bernie Moreno this coming Sunday, October 20, 2024. The invitation is attached. Invite friends and family. President Trump needs Bernie Moreno (and **not** Sherrod Brown) in DC to help him drain the swamp in his second term.

#2 please review your ballot before you go vote. Download, or pick up, your sample ballot in advance of voting. There are 76 “different” ballot styles in Shelby County for this election because many small municipalities and jurisdictions have issues or candidates that relate only to them and to nobody else in the county. It is best to review “your” sample ballot before you go vote. Information is attached.

#3 please vote early. Don’t gamble with your vote by waiting until Nov 5 to cast it. Nobody knows what tomorrow holds. Natural, or man-made, disasters can change everything without a moment’s notice as we’ve seen all too often lately. Think back to 2020 when everything changed at the last minute in Ohio. Please vote early and BANK YOUR VOTE at the Board of Elections. It will be safe and secure there!!! As President Trump says, “**let’s make this too big to rig”**. Information on how to do this is attached. As of last night, here are the quantities of ballots cast so far, sorted by the voter’s party affiliation, in Shelby County:

Keep up the good (fight, fight, fight)!!!

Cheers...Dan

P.S. Our January meeting will feature a speaker from the FORGE Leadership Network as we seek to build the future of the Shelby County Republican Party by preparing our younger generations to lead our county, state, and nation. You won’t want to miss this meeting, especially if you have young conservatives in your life! <https://forgeleadership.org/>

body:
| | | | LET'S RETURN AMANDA CHASE TO THE VIRGINIA SENATE
---
---
|
# CONSERVATIVE
# VOTING RECORDS MATTER
---
| Friends, If you live in Senate District 10, which includes Amelia, Appomattox, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Goochland, Henrico, Hanover, Louisa or Powhatan, you will most likely vote in November, December and January. Please be on the look out after this November's General Election for a Special Election to be called to fill an open state senate seat to be vacated by John McGuire who who is expected to win this November.
Republicans will chose their nominee in December or January with the General Election expected to be January 7, the day before the General Assembly gavels in. So please stay tuned. There will be an announcement of a Special Election and then 5 days later we are expected to come up with a Republican nominee.
Typically a replacement would be selected by only a handful of party faithful who are aware of the election. I started back in July educating you about this Special Election, so that you could be made aware and demand to be included in selected our Republican nominee. It's important that McGuire's successor is chosen by We the People. This is no time for inexperience, which is why I threw my hat in the ring to run back in July, as the first candidate to announce.
In July, I fully committed to running for this state senate seat and bought a home in conservative Appomattox, where I plan to reside indefinitely.
Those who have followed me know I have both the experience and conservative voting record to hit the ground running on day one, when session will already be in progress.
While there are many Republicans vying for the seat, I'm the only candidate who will be ready day one when session is already in progress.
Talk is cheap. Actions count.
While many will say they support issues important to conservatives, yet I'm the only one running with an actual conservative voting record to prove it.
While there are a number of candidates seeking the Republican nomination for State Senate in Senate District 10 to finish John McGuire's state senate term, I'm the only candidate who has a proven voting record you can trust 100% of the time.
I have a conservative voting record you can trust all 8 years I served in the Virginia Senate:
100% Pro-family, The Family Foundations scorecard, 2016-2023
100% Pro-gun, VCDL Virginia Citizen's Defense League, 2016-2023
A rating, NRA, 2016-2023
100% Pro-small business, National Federation of Independent Business, 2016-2023.
You can trust me. I'm experienced. I have a conservative voting record you can trust, and I'm willing to stand when it's important to stand on our conservative principles. Sometimes that means speaking up and challenging the status quo.
You have the opportunity to support an award winning effective conservative senator with 8 years of experience as a senator and a 100 percent conservative voting record you can trust and who knows how to win for the people.
Today, I ask for your vote if you live in Amelia, Appomattox, Buckingham, Cumberland, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Prince Edward, Henrico, Hanover and Powhatan in the upcoming Special Election.
If you live outside the district, I ask for your most generous donation. You may not be able to vote for me, but I can certainly vote for you.
---

# KEY LEGISLATIVE WINS
---

---
|

* James River Association River Hero, James River Association
* Industrial Strength Leadership Award, VMA Virginia Manufacturer's Association PAC

* Veterans For America First, 2023
* Virginia Society for Human Life, 2019

---
|
# MY FAITH IN JESUS
---
|
# WHY I STAND
---
| My faith in God through Jesus is central to who I am. It doesn't mean I'm perfect, but through all of the trials, persecution and struggles, it's my faith that I turn to and from which I draw strength during the good times and the more challenging times.
I accepted Jesus into my heart when I was in the 2nd grade. As a young teen and young adult my relationship with the Lord became more personal. I felt compelled to go on several missions trips and while in college at Virginia Tech was very involved with Campus Crusade for Christ, which is now called Cru.
It was during my college years that I began to study the Bible and my faith strengthened. I remember spending my spring break in Daytona sharing the gospel of Christ with people on the beach.
As a young adult who worked full time in management in the finance and banking field, I spent some week nights and weekends visiting people who had visited our church and led several small group Bible studies.
As a young mother, I left corporate America to raise and homeschool our 4 children under a religious exemption statue. It was then I began to volunteer for the Family Foundation and led various programs and coops for homeschool families seeking opportunities for their children. It was also then that I began to volunteer for various political campaigns for conservative Republicans.
One thing lead to another and my volunteerism lead to serving as campaign staff, political director and even campaign manager for various federal, state and local elected officials.
Ultimately, I would run and win a state senate seat, overcoming a 28 year incumbent. I served in the Virginia Senate for 8 years from 2016 to 2023, until I was "defeated" by 375 mail-in and early votes out of 22,000 votes, in which my campaign was denied overseeing of the early voting machines.
I contested the race, but was ultimately ignored by the Virginia State Board of Elections and the Republican Party of Virginia. We sought justice legally, but we were ignored. The people of Senate District 12 were disenfranchised but no one had the boldness to investigate our concern, despite our best efforts to fight the injustice. It was a frustrating experience but at the end of the day I trusted the Lord to ultimately bring justice.
Many of you have heard me say the Holy Spirit is my GPS. That is true.
Like many of you, I too get distracted and take the longer route because I wasn't paying attention. However, my heart is to put God first every morning, listen to His voice and follow the path that He has laid before me through doors that I believe He opens and closes. While I believe my loss was nefarious at best, it was a door God closed. And one I had a hard time accepting because of the appearance of cheating.
I've had former employees who had worked for me in the past and been good to literally stab me in the back. They accepted money from other elected officials who I had challenged on various policies to betray and defame my good character and reputation. They came after me politically, professionally and personally. A Richmond General District Court judge granted me a protective order against one employee who continues to follow me to this day.
Why? Because I wasn't popular with the other politicians. I wouldn't just go along to get along. I took a stand.
Life begins at conception, not 15 weeks, for starters. I refused to approve a Health and Human Resources Cabinet member because they refused to reverse Governor Northam's position regarding healthcare providers ability to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
I refused to rejoin the Republican Senate Caucus until the leader resigned because he had introduced bills to increase taxes and even introduced a gun control bill. I could not in good conscience sit under a leader who was introducing bills only a Democrat would introduce. Standing came at a cost.
I had my committee assignments taken away, my seniority taken away and my seat moved to the farthest side of the Virginia Senate chamber and my colleagues . All in an attempt to shame me into submission.
No matter what they did to me or said about me, I chose to stand.
---
|
# TAKING A STAND DURING COVID
---
|
# REFUSING TO WEAR A MASK
---
| During Covid, I refused to wear a mask. As a result, the Senate staff built a plexiglass wall around my desk. I referred to as my "Wall of Freedom."
Overnight, we saw America become a socialist nation. Our basic ability to breathe was now being governed by an overreaching tyrannical government.
Even the manufacturer of the masks printed a disclaimer stating the masks did not protect people from the spread of viruses. In fact, it was later proven that masks actually cause harm and increase a person's chances of contracting a respiratory virus.
I introduced many bills to make it illegal for employers, educators and even small businesses from violating our civil rights. These decisions of body autonomy we could determine for ourselves. I called on the government to stop restricting our ability to work, get educated or simply perform everyday activities like shop and visit the doctor for simply refusing the experimental jab.
I introduced legislation that would allow doctors to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
---
|
---
| Our Constitutional rights were being violated and I had to take a stand, no matter the cost. Wearing a mask or not should have been a choice, not a mandate.
---
|
---
| My colleagues complied with the mandates. I did not. I was both isolated and ostracized by my colleagues for standing. The Senate Clerk staff put my desk at the back of the room in a far corner. They tried to break me, but I stood strong.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, I was running for Governor. During the day I would serve in the Senate of Virginia. In the evenings, I campaigned across the state. No mask. No vaccine. People were desperate for someone who would stand up for them under the Constitutional mandates.
---
|
---
| Here's a picture of the Virginia Senate in 2021, during the height of Covid. We were forced to meet at the Science Museum of Virginia so that we could comply with social distancing mandates, which we've now discovered were a hoax and nothing more than political science.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, who stood up for you? Who fought the unconstitutional mandates? I did. And it came at a cost.
---
|
---
| Who can you count on to stand with you in the future? Who has had the courage, fortitude and history of standing with you in the past?
Standing wasn't easy. Even comedian Jimmy Kimmel mocked me nationally for refusing to wear a mask. They wanted to break me, but I stood strong in the midst of isolation, being mocked and ridiculed.
I continued to challenge the mask and vaccine mandates. They were making decisions based on political science, not science. Today, 4 years later, we know know the truth.
You can count on me. I've stood with you in the past. I will stand with you in the future.
---
| | [WRIC INTERVIEW](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eq4w8EpIr_i6FkC7vv9_HVv_tZLnEJtO0AA8o1nZmkQrel2MJIC2JXCtVSLefzMCJTxGxrNGyvigk-QG2wuMCkevax6hPxB1OTApu5NB2clprPxiwlRpmrSDkF_mkYxhik1-ZO9MOnQMSUmCPstsbzCeFqb4Ihg2FXbmfx3EbTSuf9Bks2cbCSRnGO2SAyduuF--92nHQfqxP9r7fRzZjCyCPKjI26SsJaYbzFew-rghFY6WT8KWKuXqtIG0tjpY&c=EmgqQG31iA7BUON5x7C9cBxnoach9WtXEQPvhGdxZ1GRXaJ9QBOI1w==&ch=-Zy4I29O3nM86hJA90a4zsWFaXpKoa_3nEZe5JTfAKVehQzwNDg2wA==)
---
|
# I STAND FOR MEDICAL FREEDOM
---
| I did not get the jab. And I fought for your right not to get the jab. The government should not mandate an experimental "vaccine."
---
|
---
|

---
|
---
| Dr. Sheila Furey, the President of VAMFA Virginia Medical Freedom Alliance and I worked very closely together on legislation that I sponsored to push back against onerous and unconstitutional mandates.
---
|

|
---
| Pictured: Dr. Robert Malone, Senator Amanda Chase and Dr. Paul Marik.
Dr. Robert Malone was the inventor of the Covid vaccine. Although he took the jab, he later withdrew his support and is now actively exposing the truth about the side effects of the vaccine, to include death.
Dr. Paul Marik spoke as a subject matter expert on several of my medical freedom bills. People want choice not mandates.
---
|
# STANDING FOR THE 2ND AMENDMENT
---
| Many of you heard me speak at the 2020 VCDL Legislative Day at the Capitol when there were well over 50,000 gun loving Virginians who arrived in Virginia.
You can trust me to protect your gun rights. To me it's personal. You can trust me to stand up for the 2nd Amendment.
---

Instead of protecting individual rights for people to protect themselves, the Democrats were more interested in protecting the criminals, including violent offenders. | | STANDING UP FOR INNOCENT LIFE THOSE WHO CAN'T SPEAK UP FOR THEMSELVES | The Pro-family, non-profit group, The Family Foundation issues a legislative scorecard so that Virginians can see how their legislator scores on pro-family issues. For my entire 8 year legislative career, year after year from 2016 through 2023, I received a perfect score of 100%. You can trust that I will stand for life, because I have a voting record you can trust. Not just my words. | | Life begins at fertilization. Even 98% of scientists agree. I introduced a Life Begins at Conception bill. The Senate Rules Committee refused to make a motion to vote up or down on the bill. If they voted for the bill, they would have to agree that life begins at conception. If they voted down the bill, they would oppose the opinion of 98% of scientists. | | I've been honored to speak at Family Foundation organized pro-life rallies at the Virginia State Capitol. After SCOTUS overturned the Landmark Roe vs Wade Case, CNN asked for an interview. I'm not afraid to stand for life. | | | == | I led the effort in the Virginia Senate to defeat the so called Equal Right Amendment, a failed amendment that was resurrected from the 70s. The false claim was that it should be passed to give women equal rights and codify it in the Constitution. The real agenda was to promote gender fluidity, a concept that seemed so foreign until today. I was an outspoken leader against the so called Equal Rights Amendment. Listen as I speak against SJR 284 on the floor of the Virginia Senate. | == | I've worked under two Democrat governors and one Republican governor. There are different strategies that have to be used for each. Under a Democrat governor, we know pro-life legislation will not pass. So do we continue to introduce legislation even when we know it will not pass? I believe that we should and I do. It's important that we put legislators on the record so that voters know how they will vote when we do have the votes and it does count. | | | | | The late Virginia Senator Eva Mae Scott (R-Amelia) and I speak at a press conference organized by The Family Foundation against the so-called Equal Rights Amendment. | STANDING UP FOR SECURE ELECTIONS MAKING SURE YOUR VOTE COUNTS | | When voters in my senate district went to cast their vote in 2020, many said that they couldn't vote because someone had already cast their vote for them. I was determined to investigate and get to the bottom of this, despite efforts to be shamed into not questioning the 2020 Presidential Election results. | | I flew to Arizona to witness the first ever full forensic audit so that I knew what legislation to introduce in Virginia. Clearly there was a national effort to steal our elections and what they were doing in Arizona was happening all across the country, but only Republican controlled legislators were able to investigate. I worked very closely with the Arizona legislature. My hope was to have a full forensic audit right here in Virginia, but the legislature was completely controlled by the Democrats. So I sought to expose what was happening across the country, and eventually right here in Virginia. | | Pictured: Arizona State Senator Wendy Rodgers, Senator Amanda Chase, Representative Mark Finchem and Senator Sonny Borrelli. | | The Voter Confidence Restoration Act was just one of many bills that I introduced to put the guardrails back on our Virginia elections and restore voter confidence in our elections. While my goal was ultimately a full forensic audit of the 2020 election, I knew that wouldn't happen with a Democrat controlled legislature. So, I led the effort to simply go back to our Virginia Election Law best practices prior to covid, back when we required photo ID to vote, we had an election day instead of an election season and there were no drop boxes. | | While in South Dakota at the Mike Lindell Cyber Symposium I founded the National Election Integrity Caucus for legislators across the country. Together we worked on and shared legislative ideas and bills to assist with our election integrity efforts. | | STANDING UP ON JAN 6 | I was there on January 6. But I did not go into the nation's Capitol. Many of us believed the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen and joining the protest at the Capitol in DC with President Trump to exercise our First Amendment right to free speech and to contest the election results. We were counting on Vice President Mike Pence to do the right thing. Unfortunately, he did not and his political career is over. I stand up for true election integrity. As a result, I was censured by the Virginia Senate with 3 Republicans joining. | | | | STANDING UP FOR SAFER COMMUNITIES LOCKING UP VIOLENT CRIMINALS | Over the past 8 years, I have introduced legislation to support our law enforcement to include the Law Enforcement Bill of Rights. I voted against repealing qualified immunity. | | YOU CAN TRUST ME TO STAND | When you are considering who you are going to support for State Senate in District 10, (Appomattox, Amelia, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Powhatan, Hanover and the Shady Grove precinct in Henrico) ask yourself who has the experience to start on Day One? ## China Deploys 125 Warplanes Near Taiwan
China deployed a record 125 warplanes, along with its Liaoning aircraft carrier, in large-scale military drills near Taiwan on Monday. [See photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQAL8GOqL1YjAULl6TLq-9Eq3X67AnA5GxEuXvT7n-ytEUI83XbbmRZt3v_2kTX9OxEFd9ymKgM0OHdrFt9EkEpW_FG4fTPCOMtl09g3UAIxqapxSGaQrIkTGmGIAYuVWPgNaAGQzAbMYLMMgcAvbgeMSBGgsStR7l8n3oXldJ-X08pVz42Nrs11ofZ9P_a_Da4JUeu7zOj_pAqcpZGrxW0hftHa-6U7dp1krl3cWiOZ8dDH0KFCkZg0MQSzGJOHIyRsPi5rb4-HhpznqOrrFw30jzb73-MePp8ScAAP__uvxhlQ).The exercises, simulating a blockade of key ports, followed Taiwan's National Day celebrations, where President Lai Ching-te rejected Beijing's sovereignty claims over the island.China described the drills as punishment for Taiwan's pursuit of independence. Taiwan's defense ministry responded by tracking Chinese military movements, while the U.S. urged Beijing to exercise restraint to maintain regional peace.State Department spokesperson [Matthew Miller criticized](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb_GdI7GYwOhcPGkJ7psuyUazBBmZWxkvIny96tsv_WV7jk6n7fpRhIl3T9oZ1_XPFGo8uDJgDatRje5ZvErM7Jt2Jser8OA0Llm8xTCYPo1mKtr2znQanGY7XwF6g2D6xvxCOgMmNYADKa7QAAe5hkt9KHDlpQDXqTmcvnKkurGa3zlB5dLyHsT_VbrcSr7T-GocKwbbxLje1M4HjlKeCkcJVUuiarkRFHh6AaLAEZ_n7qQnHzqkFPgkvT7WYdNEp-sd4lSqbz0UiTGUyemoivJk9IbZ8c6F16V_b8dTfHL8ZQY5ex65eC-k_xqNPWPYg-PPwEAAP__AcJvHA) China's response as unwarranted and warned that it risked escalating tensions.
## Harris, Trump Head to Fox News on Wednesday
Vice President Kamala Harris will appear [in her first interview with Fox News](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFu5CAQgOGngY7VMGBYFxTXuNtrr7QwHi9zwmaFkTd5-yjpU__SX3z_HvMjcuHj-TfuFPpW55g6XzRrUHpQaGcr17ARIRlJQXu8jyOCszIHb711ycc0uCUu3iUzeqC46QUJ7sZIDghoNehBA4za3SABjcuCBnxyOERhgVbutd3-Vz56pq181ovaLdVdlpB7f53C_BE4CZx6psylfDeBU647HfQ-BU47rRwFTnY0iN6oixOpV6OTVzq6yrE1PhUfndrF9FZb_RA4yRbW15tL4dN5YeG5R_6Zy_6LwxXwKwAA__9MPF-a) on Wednesday at 6 p.m. ET on _Special Report_ with Bret Baier from Pennsylvania.This interview comes as Harris has increased her media appearances, including interviews on ABC's _The View,_ _The Howard Stern Show,_ and _Stephen Colbert._ Meanwhile, Former President Donald Trump will participate [in a town hall focused on women's issues](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuxCAQBNCvgY7TssZwFBRp3F3alBa2l4MIjOUjdvL3kdOnnnkaaT4e48OnnNbnuy_kWqijn1s6aJQgZC9QjYovLhAhdZycNHi3FkErHh2YoClYuk_ShEmaPnSLkp0CEyQCKZ4cAioJspcAVuobzEB2mrADM2vsPVNAS2p1v33WtLZIIf_Ug_bbXAvPLra2vVj3xnBgOLRIMeV8ZQyHWAutdL4YDrMvm0_PleGgLN6NtqLtX2UToX6LqyNaPVcRfc7ivJg4aqP9onx3y3amnNNLG6bgWXz6W-DtnzMOh78BAAD__yyTYWM), hosted by Fox News anchor Harris Faulkner. The event will take place in Cumming, Georgia, with an all-female audience and will air on _The Faulkner Focus_ Wednesday at 11 a.m. ET.The discussion will cover key concerns for female voters, such as the economy, abortion, and healthcare, ahead of the November election.
## List: Wedding Costs by U.S. State
If you or your loved ones are planning to tie the knot, brace yourselves--especially if it's in New Jersey, where the average cost of a wedding is $55,000, [according to a new study](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zz1uhDAQQOHTmA40Hv-wLlykodu0KZHXHsCJ117BCJTbR0mf-klP-j7u8z3kkuv6Hp7keWlziJxPmiX00vSoZ90lvxAhqY68HPHmHILV3eZhtEgyEcGCJJVSLiRzM44oWuMAuuwRUEuQRgI4aQeIQO7xQAVjtGiC0EApc9uHz5Yrb7SU73bSPsT27IrfmF-HUG8CJ4HTdV0Db_RVG_92gVNslamywCmctIeV-otSynXtYzu42316XbmUfNhRaFifIZe_M_8DPT3-BAAA__90clXH).The national average sits at $35,000, with cities like New York and San Francisco pushing costs even higher, with average weddings in those cities running around $49,000 and $41,000, respectively.Couples in states like Utha, Idaho, and West Virginia generally pay less, with average wedding expenses around $17,000 to $20,000.

| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk0pof076165o6ma4op6gatjk50ps8fctff3ibao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1g64p31c3h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn7rg1fb1lnr13a7ns6uh6r4evh7u96s4in88n28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1g64p31c3h2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsc6sgt1brr50ukfidngrtnuinsk5q2dv5t8fieg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1g64p31c3h2bs)
What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

## Proxy Fight Set for Southwest Airlines
Elliott Investment Management, the hedge fund that owns 11% of Dallas-based Southwest Airlines common stock, [called for a special shareholder meeting](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQhX8N3rAOcjhmYOjiLV07WhjOMRKEyFzj9N9X7t7l6UlPep_0fd3mm085Pe6fvpDj91pnHzi9aFYglZEaZ-yiWyBa1ZFTVz1ai2bU3eZwWdH4cPGRxguQHZQJBOAHb8MaIHbJadCoQBkFZlS6B8QrrsMSBrRk0QsEionr3vNGTG_f1vxTX7T3oZYuu4352cTlQ-hJ6Ok4jj48lnCOQk_nt9CTgjPORjmnyixb_ebtoMayPSkkn2Uh4vS4y0iBykJ7v3HJ3e7i80g5pzZcBcK9-JT_wPyfiJfTvwEAAP__K4Jggg) in December to vote on replacing eight Southwest board directors. The group is seeking the ouster of Southwest CEO Bob Jordan and pushing the airline to increase profitability by ending long-standing practices such as open seating. It's the private equity firm's first proxy fight since 2017. _" Absent a thorough reconstitution of its Board, the story of Southwest will remain one of empty promises and unfulfilled potential,"_ [hedge fund officials said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGP4yAQRn8N7rBgDmxTUFzjLtdeaQ0wiZGwicysnf33q6Tf9vv09KT3_7bcMJe8P_7hRp5f97pg5HzSopXUVoJZTJd8UMnpjrweYXLO2Am61ZM2aJMdh2gVToMOzk7oEGJIGKIZuuxBgdFKW63spKFXxozmPoQ4GEfOoDCKUuZ69LwS0wvbvXzXk44-1q0rfmV-NvHnr4BZwHxdVx9D2-lq71_A_EEEzO9JwNzqF68XNZaYj5J3ajJUPJI8K5OkUnJllnk_qfFGOwuYu8On55VLyW0YhVGPDXP52Pm3GqeHnwAAAP__BC9kkA).
## Venezuelan Gang Member Arrested
A member of the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua, 32-year-old Jorgenys Robertson Cova, has been arrested in Houston for theft and is suspected of [attempting to recruit middle school students](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGypCAQAL8GMyyYHV0JCC4x20svtGZlVOoQtgB1777-1dv8xR10V_95TA_ywcf1N-1s63tJE83VnzxpJXUnASdsnH0qZ3TDVt9hMAa7AZrNEtOA2Bu-GacVPAetuqU3S4cIpGZovAUFqJXutOoGDa1CvOPSP-ceDRskgYqdrym3dePKbypL-JdOzu2c9ibYrdZXEbdfAkYB43Vd7ZLeka_yzQWMRxEwnhz5_8GBoqyZo3QsKdN6kFwprjLznA9ffVzlX--KTEeVH5XcvXOBZZm3lEJpsnWvy4fgS38XqNadfPh01J--nBa-AgAA__-B7GfS) for a shoplifting ring. Cova crossed the border illegally in 2022 and has been [charged with multiple burglaries](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtuxCAQRb8Gd6xgFj8oKNLQbdqUFjaDjYRhBeN9_H206VNf3aOj83Obby6mmLdvd6ChVyizWyk-cJaCy56DmlXnzSK8lh0aOcKkteon6HbjNSyAVz8FIfW4BH_tpQ7jMK39qEPALhoQoKSQvRT9JOEilBpVGJZ1UBq1ckwJ9JFKvdCOhC_XQnqXB9bLWo4umZ3o3tj1i4FlYPP7Xhp9Jgb2Q2ZgpWBghWZgz8YzPhsDSxUz98hdddvp-Obyxg88Fqy84lrPSOj5Eb1PyNu6l5J4o9Njps-7q8bfnzGl2IaRKbEdLqY_H_qvz8PAbwAAAP__uN9nzw) in Texas and Arizona. Officials say he targeted vulnerable teens because they face fewer legal consequences when caught. The allegations against Cova add to the growing list of criminal activity associated with the violent Venezuelan gang.
## Texas Ranked 7th in Most Stressed Workers
Texas ranks near the top of a [list of states with the most stressed workers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vgzAQQH8NbEb2cXx48NAlW7p2RIc5ghUDkX2N039fpXvHJz3pSe_rOl0pxHDcPmlnJ6_1nMhLePJktDKdApywXtysF2tqdmaA0VrsRqg3B0zD7OfFt-jR2nYl8K3GZQTbr2RtHRxoQKNNZ3Q3Gmg04oBrP_seLVukCjUvQc7UyMbCL8pr_DmfnBp_7nV0m8gjV-1HBZcKLqWU5uCSC_P9LVRwmTmLKmfKomjnFDy96a6yJM5Z7XwIRbUxRdlUPL9DDnSQMrYf-lbXyS2PEmIMuR8q1LedQvxLy38rng5-AwAA___cJmLU), coming in 7th, according to a study by personal injury firm Premier Law Group. The study used data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Census Bureau to compute a "stress score" for each state based on average hourly earnings, working hours, injury rates, commute times, and opportunities to work remotely. [Texas scored 58.5](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAQAL8Gd0SwWZtQUFzjLtdeaWFYx9xhY8E6yf39U17_-tFoNH_u092nnPbHb7-R4_dSJh84PWnSSupeAk7YRTeraHVHThu4WYv9DbrVBSIdBn8dZmPjvEQDEI1FC1b1PRrdJQcKUCvda9XfNFwUosFlmMOAlix6gYpi4lIvvBLT27cl_y9PqpdQti67lflo4vpLwChgfJQSN9qPWv5S4A8iYFzI81kpylB2pp0FjFtpLBtXam05s3yV-u_IPlCTaZe8kjxlk5WOc84p-F029kxNcjlkTu1j6KqLxyvlnNpgBKrH5lP-buKfHj0dfAUAAP__GJZsmg), behind first-place Louisiana, which received a score of 73.8. West Virginia, Mississippi, Kentucky, Nevada, and Arkansas also scored higher than Texas. Meanwhile, Minnesota ranks as the state with the least stressed workers, with a score of 32.6.

Pueblo’s Democratic Party faces $2 million campaign finance scandal
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
I'm excited to announce that me and lots of my Western Slope friends will be coming together for another Rocky Mountain Rumble in Grand Junction this weekend! Check out the details below and make sure to RSVP. Can't wait to see you there!
\-- _Join Rocky Mountain Voice Founder Heidi Ganahl, and special guests Rose Pugliese, Janice Rich, Cody Davis, Bobbie Daniel, Andrea Haitz, Marc Catlin & Sean Pond for an evening of inspiration, food, drinks, and live music. **This event is FREE to attend, but an RSVP is required for security reasons._

**Date & Time: **October 20th, 4-6pm **Location:** Clifton Community Center | Clifton, CO **[CLICK HERE TO RSVP!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 15, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[RSVP FOR FREE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Pueblo’s Democratic Party faces $2 million campaign finance scandal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** COMMENTARY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The Pueblo Democratic Party is at the center of a significant campaign finance scandal, following a complaint that has exposed years of financial misconduct._
_While the statute of limitations may cap their liability at $25,000, the total violations could exceed $2 million if all infractions were accounted. The revelations suggest that the party has evaded financial reporting laws for more than a decade, raising serious questions about accountability._
_The complaint targets the financial activities of the Pueblo County Democratic Central Committee, which operates as an ancillary entity to the Pueblo Democratic Party. Colorado law, specifically Article XXVIII of the State Constitution and 1-45-108 C.R.S., requires transparency in campaign finance reporting. However, the Central Committee, registered as a nonprofit with the Secretary of State, has failed to report significant financial transactions as required._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[5th District debate between Crank, Gassen is Tuesday, hosted by Gazette, KOAA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Republican Jeff Crank and Democrat River Gassen will meet Tuesday in a 5th District debate hosted by the Colorado Springs Gazette and KOAA-TV NBC 5 in coordination with the El Pomar Foundation.
* The winner of the race will replace U.S. Rep. Doug Lamborn in the U.S. House of Representatives at the end of his term.
* The debate will take place from 4-5:30 p.m. at the Penrose House Garden Pavilion, 1661 Mesa Ave. in Colorado Springs.
* More detail on the debate is available at The Gazette or KOAA-TV NBC 5.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Resolution claims Denver placed illegals in Aurora without notice, would begin investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Aurora City Council is considering a resolution that claims Denver relocated immigrants to Aurora without notifying local officials, sparking calls for an investigation.
* The resolution, sponsored by Councilmember Danielle Jurinsky, directs the city manager to list organizations that received funding to aid immigrants, including support from Denver.
* The resolution follows former President Trump's rally in Aurora, where he criticized the Biden administration’s immigration policies and linked them to gang problems in the city, which Aurora's mayor disputed.
* Aurora Mayor Mike Coffman and other officials pushed back on claims about a severe gang issue, calling them exaggerated, while local Democrats criticized Trump for divisive rhetoric.
* The council will hold a meeting on Monday to discuss the resolution, with the investigation and public comments expected during the session.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Governor silent on whether he’ll use far-left smear factory to cancel conservatives after flag squabble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Governor Jared Polis has not addressed concerns about using the Southern Poverty Law Center's (SPLC) criteria to exclude conservative groups from a state flag program after honoring Gays Against Groomers.
* Polis' office apologized for allowing the group, labeled as a "hate group" by the SPLC, to participate in the program, and announced plans to update vetting procedures.
* The flag program was suspended after backlash, with promises of more thorough reviews in the future.
* Gays Against Groomers criticized the SPLC for spreading misinformation and profiting from labeling groups as hate organizations. The SPLC's "hate map" has faced criticism, including accusations of unjustly targeting ideological opponents.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ballots have been mailed to Colorado voters. Here’s when to expect yours.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado voters will begin receiving their ballots in the mail starting Oct. 11, with all ballots expected to arrive by Oct. 28 for the Nov. 5 election.
* Registered voters can track their ballots through BallotTrax and request replacements if their ballot is lost, damaged, or not received.
* Voters can cast their ballots by mail, drop box, or in person, but all ballots must be received by 7 p.m. on Election Day.
* Voter registration remains open until Election Day, allowing late registrants to still receive mail-in ballots if registered by Oct. 28.
* In-person voting and ballot drop-off options are available across Colorado, with polling locations listed on the Secretary of State’s website.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[California government blocks new Musk rocket launches, citing Trump support](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The California Coastal Commission blocked a request to increase SpaceX's rocket launches, citing Elon Musk's political statements and involvement in the presidential race as a concern.
* The U.S. Department of Defense and a bipartisan group of lawmakers supported the expansion, while some questioned the legality of considering Musk's political speech in regulatory decisions.
* Critics, including housing advocates and First Amendment defenders, argued that the decision improperly factored in Musk's political views, raising concerns about free speech violations.
* Musk announced plans to file a lawsuit against the California Coastal Commission, while SpaceX continues to make strides in its space flight efforts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Daniel: Leave wildlife management to CPW, vote no on Prop. 127](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BOBBIE DANIEL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Proposition 127, currently under debate in Colorado, aims to impose a blanket ban on hunting mountain lions, bobcats and lynx. However, it is important to clarify some of the misleading claims surrounding this measure._
_First, lynx are federally-protected and are not at risk of being hunted in Colorado. Additionally, “trophy” hunting is already illegal in the state._
_Although the proposition may appear to promote wildlife preservation, it disregards the critical role that Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) plays in maintaining balanced ecosystems and safeguarding rural communities. This isn’t just a hunting ban—it restricts CPW’s ability to manage these species effectively under the guise of wildlife protection. If passed, the consequences for Colorado’s environment, rural economy and CPW’s conservation efforts could be severe._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

This wasn’t just a new way to lead, but a completely different approach to organizing and managing life in the service._

Registered voters can track their ballots through BallotTrax and request replacements if their ballot is lost, damaged, or not received. Voters can cast their ballots by mail, drop box, or in person, but all ballots must be received by 7 p.m. on Election Day. Voter registration remains open until Election Day, allowing late registrants to still receive mail-in ballots if registered by Oct. 28. In-person voting and ballot drop-off options are available across Colorado, with polling locations listed on the Secretary of State’s website. | The California Coastal Commission blocked a request to increase SpaceX's rocket launches, citing Elon Musk's political statements and involvement in the presidential race as a concern. The U.S. Department of Defense and a bipartisan group of lawmakers supported the expansion, while some questioned the legality of considering Musk's political speech in regulatory decisions. Critics, including housing advocates and First Amendment defenders, argued that the decision improperly factored in Musk's political views, raising concerns about free speech violations. Musk announced plans to file a lawsuit against the California Coastal Commission, while SpaceX continues to make strides in its space flight efforts. | BY BOBBIE DANIEL, Proposition 127, currently under debate in Colorado, aims to impose a blanket ban on hunting mountain lions, bobcats and lynx. Additionally, “trophy” hunting is already illegal in the state. Although the proposition may appear to promote wildlife preservation, it disregards the critical role that Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) plays in maintaining balanced ecosystems and safeguarding rural communities. Hey - this is Steve Scalise.

I've written A LOT of important memos over the years... But I can honestly say this is the most important one I've written to date. Please read it as soon as you get this email:
---

---
**FROM:** Steve Scalise, House Majority Leader
**TO:** Conservatives Everywhere
**RE:** The Final Sprint
* * *

Hello,

With the General Election LESS than 3 weeks away - _and the Democrat Machine firing on all cylinders_ -- our already-fragile Conservative House Majority hangs by a thread.

Below is our plan to save it.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Democrats have a **2-POINT EDGE** over Republicans in the latest Generic Ballot. And they are currently out raising us by $30 million in toss-up races.

Fundraising is where close elections are won and lost. And right now, Democrats have the upper hand. They're using their multi-million dollar lead to flood the airwaves with vicious and dishonest ads against our Conservative candidates

At this point, control of Congress is anyone's game.

**IMPORTANT CONTEXT**

House Republicans are the **ONLY FIREWALL** right now standing in the way of Chuck Schumer, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris ramming through whatever they want. That includes gutting voter ID, packing the Supreme Court, eviscerating our God-given rights, and making Washington DC a state.

As of right now, our House Majority is extremely fragile - if we lose even a few seats, the Democrats will immediately take control.

**THE PROBLEM**

We are losing the fundraising battle. Our budgets for recruiting volunteers, knocking on doors in swing states, keeping our ads on the airwaves, and turning out GOP voters are running **DANGEROUSLY LOW.**

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

I am personally asking you to make a donation today. It does not matter to me if it's $10 or $100 - every penny counts. Each donation brings us closer to sealing this election for Republicans up and down the ballot.

_**[So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq451kjp64j065p256qp7rubv2eu4df2vu20rsc0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1g61o32cjh2bs "So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.")**_

Thank you,
Steve Scalise
---

Before I go, just remember this:

The future of our country is resting on our shoulders right now and what you do today could be the final push we need in our last days before the election. _So what do you say, will you step up and make a donation today?_

Folks, we’ve reached a critical turning point in this race, and **[I’m humbly asking you to make a split donation to my campaign today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95034491/505382764/73003207?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5526-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzVkNGFlMS1mMThhLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_bEcJWujpyFSIn6UgDdGiyUGqDMXLJh-7-SMvNlVHm8=)** But first, I owe you an explanation.
Tonight, we’ll face our **last** mid-month fundraising deadline before Election Day.
As you read this, Mitch McConnell is making his final spending decisions. If our report shows any signs of weakness, he’ll launch a new round of attacks — **and we won’t have the chance to fight back before Montanans start voting.**

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2069%2E135344%2E8usvRG)

Friends --
In just a moment, we are going to ask you to make a well-timed contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate in Michigan. Please give us a chance to explain why this request -- especially before our final FEC deadline ends tomorrow -- is so important.
Here's the truth:
Last night was the final debate of the campaign.
We hope you watched it, but if you didn't, rest assured you would have been proud of Elissa.
Our opponent, Mike Rogers ... he had no answers for his previous support for abortion bans, raising the Social Security retirement age, his support of Betsy DeVos who has worked tirelessly to destroy public schools, and a whole host of other issues.
But while it is pretty clear Elissa won last night's debate, debates on their own don't win elections. They help, but Elissa doesn't just get handed a Senate seat because she did a better job last night.
Winning takes the work of volunteers, and it takes resources. Right now, we need the resources to reach the remaining undecided voters and to turn out infrequent Democratic voters -- especially before the final FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign ends tomorrow.
So while Elissa did her job last night, now she needs those of us who can to do our part:
[**Can Elissa count on you to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, directly to her campaign for U.S. Senate? body:
Thank the Lord this reached you in time...

| |

---
| | | _Thank the Lord this reached you in time ..._

Hey - this is Steve Scalise.

I've written A LOT of important memos over the years... But I can honestly say this is the most important one I've written to date. Please read it as soon as you get this email:
---
| | | [READ MY MEMO HERE](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6fvoarveot3gfrsi5pg27qutq708mhl87f7d3f0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1i68or4cth2bs "READ MY MEMO HERE")
---
**FROM:** Steve Scalise, House Majority Leader
**TO:** Conservatives Everywhere
**RE:** The Final Sprint
* * *

Hello,

With the General Election LESS than 3 weeks away - _and the Democrat Machine firing on all cylinders_ -- our already-fragile Conservative House Majority hangs by a thread.

Below is our plan to save it.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Democrats have a **2-POINT EDGE** over Republicans in the latest Generic Ballot. And they are currently out raising us by $30 million in toss-up races.

Fundraising is where close elections are won and lost. And right now, Democrats have the upper hand. They're using their multi-million dollar lead to flood the airwaves with vicious and dishonest ads against our Conservative candidates

At this point, control of Congress is anyone's game.

**IMPORTANT CONTEXT**

House Republicans are the **ONLY FIREWALL** right now standing in the way of Chuck Schumer, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris ramming through whatever they want. That includes gutting voter ID, packing the Supreme Court, eviscerating our God-given rights, and making Washington DC a state.

As of right now, our House Majority is extremely fragile - if we lose even a few seats, the Democrats will immediately take control.

**THE PROBLEM**

We are losing the fundraising battle. Our budgets for recruiting volunteers, knocking on doors in swing states, keeping our ads on the airwaves, and turning out GOP voters are running **DANGEROUSLY LOW.**

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

I am personally asking you to make a donation today. It does not matter to me if it's $10 or $100 - every penny counts. Each donation brings us closer to sealing this election for Republicans up and down the ballot.

_**[So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuuqoo0md0ld0mo2tiuf7havnahkk7e8d82i7hi0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1i68or4cth2bs "So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.")**_

Thank you,
Steve Scalise
---

Before I go, just remember this:

The future of our country is resting on our shoulders right now and what you do today could be the final push we need in our last days before the election. _So what do you say, will you step up and make a donation today?_

As thousands of our National Guards and active-duty service members continue to conduct heroic relief missions by air, land and water across the Southeast, we wanted to share some new photos from their historic response to Hurricanes Helene and Milton.
[](https://links.e.uso.)

Service members from the Florida and South Carolina National Guard search for survivors at a destroyed property near Stuart, Florida. The area was decimated by tornadoes caused by Hurricane Milton as the storm progressed across the state.

---

[RUSH AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://links.e.uso.)
---

---
Soldiers deliver water, meals and nonperishable goods to senior citizens in communities devastated by Hurricane Milton.
[RUSH AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://links.e.uso.)

It's clear the recovery from these two disasters will be long, but the USO is committed to being there for our service members at every step of the way.

Thank you for your urgent support.
--The USO

Tonight at midnight — just a few hours from now — marks our FINAL mid-month fundraising deadline before the November 5th election. **Dems, GOP Must Unite In Cracking Down On Middlemen Who Cause Drug Costs To Skyrocket**[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=426dfb9c942f4e5b80c5f94127fe531a&_e=SVTHxo0Mp17K-rHQW5B3_gUIvdfSDmh_dxEyEthymeOh1T-jTbrgDzYEossHlWy-8nuHeSL673CogJ6FOppUrgSMqZ2wbC8p2ddItNMu4j7W3v0oHp3N2h8zYL6Z51uEu4Q2slodrXocZzIjf1h8c3gUexascEb6C4xaS7ec4fNVpGyQSJ3t9Hri7wWfkBhIlIX8NOsvPWYIilyiF1zyoxzuOeCllv92OPcaVhULNYg%3D "View More Articles By Bobby Jindal And Charlie Katebi") By Bobby Jindal and Charlie Katebi
---
Over the past several years, lawmakers, healthcare practitioners and patient advocates have claimed companies known as pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) are inflating the cost of prescription drugs. Now, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is suing the largest PBMs for allegedly increasing the cost of insulin for patients with diabetes.

These middlemen manage the drug benefits for virtually all health insurance plans in the United States, negotiating prices with drug manufacturers and negotiating benefits with health plans. Since PBMs are service providers working on behalf of health plans and patients, they should be incentivized to design drug benefits so that patients can access the best drugs at the lowest possible cost. But, because of the perverse incentives in the market, PBMs often benefit when patients and their employers pay more for drugs.

Typically, PBMs negotiate a drug’s discount with the manufacturer on behalf of the health plan. This discount is commonly known as a rebate. These negotiations, between a manufacturer’s market access team and PBMs, center around how much of the drug can be sold and the discount that can be given based on the volume. Once the drug is sold to the patient, the rebate is passed from the manufacturer to the PBM to the plan. As payment for their services, health plans will pay their PBM a percentage of the rebate, theoretically incentivizing the PBMs to find them greater and greater rebates. **[Finish reading on DailyCaller.com](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=426dfb9c942f4e5b80c5f94127fe531a&_e=SVTHxo0Mp17K-rHQW5B3_gUIvdfSDmh_dxEyEthymeOV33sv3bIHjE_I1_CWjGBsA-Q5WM5ZtfitVAlvPbrzdFlv4TRjakZPIdoIxtlFe_x24zRlOpwEdoFnnR7S4y1Wfe31K8zsWJfXfg-wpxQYZagcwP3od-4EvdMkcc1HdnAvFq8xJpR5laREJDJIIQiB9mztynPLMHdRAn-zCrpyV2L5nXRQ6lTqN920EgN-5GxCCDIkJj0LSDQG3NXcMw8nKGz6MqIWnWLfaqwynWgJWMCwiydw2q8gZVwtg_UD85IcMasWWlX3X90ejz3aN8IS)**

Paul Davis | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |

| **__Paul Davis:_ An ICE-cold report on illegal immigrant criminals in the U.S._**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5cd1b706a5&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "Many people were taken aback by last month’s chilling report that as of July 21st, 662,566 illegal immigrants with criminal records illegally crossed over the porous Southern border.

The information about illegal immigrant criminals in our country did not come from a talking head commentator on Fox News employing hyperbole. The data came directly from the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

On September 25, Patrick J. Lechleitner, the Deputy Director and Senior Official Performing the Duties of the Director of ICE, responded to a letter about illegal immigrants charged or convicted with a crime that Congressman Tony Gonzales (R-Texas) sent the Department of Homeland Security, ICE’s parent organization..."

## About Paul Davis:
---
| |
---
Paul Davis is a South Philadelphia writer and frequent contributor to _Broad + Liberty_. He is also a regular contributor to Counterterrorism magazine, and he writes the “On Crime” column for the _Washington Times_. He enlisted in the U.S. Navy when he was 17 and served two years aboard the aircraft carrier USS Kitty Hawk during the Vietnam War. He also served two years aboard a Navy harbor tugboat at the U.S. nuclear submarine base at Holy Loch, Scotland. He performed security work as a Defense Department civilian employee after serving in the Navy, and later became a full-time writer. His work has also appeared in the _Philadelphia Inquirer_ , the _Philadelphia Daily News_ , _Philadelphia Weekly_ , and other publications.

name: No Dem Left Behind Executive Director, Hassan Martini
subject: 2024 and Beyond
body:
It is time to rally in preperation for November 5th. But the work does not stop there.
| | | | | | [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v2w2e-fg8en0-kyd76rh3/)
---
# **2024 and Beyond**
---
| | | | folks, Here we go, all eyes are on us. The country is up for grabs, and everywhere you go, everyone you talk to—you can feel it. Presidential elections are different, and this one even more so. The candidates could not be further apart in almost every sense. They have different backgrounds, policies, morals—you name it, they’re different. Here’s the thing: it’s a toss-up, and right now, it can go either way. What that means is every side is doing everything they can to reach every single possible voter. We can look them in the eye and tell them, for a fact, your vote matters—because it does. The pressure is on, and believe me, we feel it. Three weeks to go, three long or short weeks depending on how you look at it. You might not see it, but there are tens of thousands of people working tirelessly on both sides to get the win. The White House is the prize, and we want it bad. We want to take a moment to reach out and say thank you. Just by reading this email, you are showing us support. This is what we do—this is the moment we live for. But to get to this point requires incredible amounts of resources, sweat equity, sleepless nights, and exhausting days. Now, we want to zoom in a little so you can get a sense of just how difficult this job is. Imagine someone coming into your community, trying to influence you to vote for MAGA or Trump, and persuading you to see things their way. Folks, when we go into rural America, that’s what we’re walking into. Trump and the MAGA wing have a complete, dominant stronghold over rural America. We have to change that. body:
Folks, Senator Mark Warner here with an important update about the 2024 elections.
I want to talk to you directly about what’s at stake this November, and how Republicans could pull off a win in Virginia. But first, I have to ask: Will you pitch in whatever you can to my friend of 40+ years and colleague Tim Kaine’s re-election campaign before his final FEC deadline? He’s counting on supporters like you to help hold onto his seat and our Democratic Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
When I was running for re-election to the Senate in 2014, a lot of folks were complacent about the race. They essentially said: Well, Mark’s an incumbent, Barack Obama has won VA twice now, Tim Kaine was just elected two years ago...we don’t need to worry about Virginia.
They were dead wrong. I won that race by just 0.81% of the vote — it was a REALLY close call.
Since then, with two Democrats representing Virginia in the Senate, and during our recent years with a Democratic majority, we’ve been able to accomplish so much . From the American Rescue Plan and the Inflation Reduction Act, to lowering prescription drug prices, to cutting child poverty in half, to making actual progress on gun violence prevention.
In 21 days, all of that is at stake.
And I’ll be honest with you right now: I’m really worried that folks are getting complacent — just like they did with my race in 2014, and just like far too many people did in 2016.
We can’t afford complacency, we can’t afford a GOP majority in the Senate, and we definitely can’t afford Donald Trump and JD Vance in the White House.
Tim Kaine’s statewide GOTV program in Virginia is trying to prevent all of that from happening. His team is working around the clock to make sure we get record numbers of voters to the polls for his own re-election, for our Democratic House candidates, and for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz.
But he needs your help — so I’m coming to you today to ask: Will you pitch in whatever you can to Tim’s campaign? His team tells me that the average online donation is $29.
The final FEC deadline of 2024 is tomorrow at midnight, so now is a really important time to donate. You can contribute at this link or through the buttons below: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
