body:
#

Team -
Today, we hope you’ll allow us to share five reasons as to why your $5 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC is so important.
1. **We must elect Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz as the next president and vice president of the United States.** Unlike Donald Trump and JD Vance, we can trust Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to put our safety before gun lobby profits.

2. **Our gun safety Senate majority is razor-thin, and we need to take back the House of Representatives.** The only way we can continue to make progress in our gun violence prevention movement is if we replace gun lobby-backed candidates with gun safety champions.

3. **We deserve better than to live under the constant threat of gun violence.** Everyone in this nation—no matter what state they live in—should feel safe to go about their communities without the fear of being shot.

4. **Trump will be speaking at an NRA event at the end of this month.** He’ll use this appearance to rile up his MAGA base with his usual incendiary language. We need to be prepared for an uptick in NRA fundraising after Trump’s speech.

5. **Tomorrow at midnight, we’re facing our last FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day.** Right now, we’re pacing behind the $50,000 online fundraising goal we’ve set to close our budget gap. Falling short this close to Election Day could make the difference in winning or losing key races across the country.

The choice is yours to make, but we hope these five reasons demonstrate how important your donation to GIFFORDS PAC is, especially today.
[**If you’re ready to fuel our electoral work and help us have a strong FEC report in the last weeks before Election Day, please make a contribution of $5 or more to GIFFORDS PAC:**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241015-1-30&t=1&akid=9196%2E3935704%2EuZCiFf)

subject: 21 days until we elect Kamala Harris and Democrats. Or until Trump and his allies are rolling out Project 2025.
body:
We’re not going back.

Derek, Today is October 15, 2024. Election Day is just three weeks away. Three more Tuesdays until we elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats nationwide. Or until Donald Trump and right-wing billionaires like Elon Musk are rolling out their Project 2025 agenda. You already know what that means, Derek: A Trump abortion ban in all 50 states. Donald Trump without any guardrails. **We don’t have to live in that world.** We can elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats nationwide to chart a new way forward. To turn the page on the hate and the vitriol that has divided us for too long. **But we have to choose that future, Derek.** The other side is backed by extreme billionaires. subject: It’s the Senate, Stupid
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR
BY SENATE CONSERVATIVES ACTION AND NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWv-_pPWNy

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWv-_pPWNy

You've
probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan,
"It's the Economy, Stupid." Clinton's political strategist, James
Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team
focussed and on the message.

The
slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight
Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a
freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

"It's the
Senate, Stupid."

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this
year, but winning the White House - as critical as it is - won't
be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate.
Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his
appointees or enact his second-term agenda.

A
Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a
waste of a Republican president.

That's
why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate
candidates across the nation.

A
president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the
bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation
will never be signed into law.

Does
anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President
Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand
American energy, and restore election integrity?

Of course
not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense
policies will be passed.

And if
Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats
from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without
debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

As we
head into the final days of this election, we must support the
conservatives running for U.S. Senate.

These
eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make
America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't
liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

WIN THE
SENATE

Contribute to these Senate candidates and help push them on to
victory.

DONATE
NOW

These
Senate races will not receive the same media attention as the
presidential race, but they are no less important.

If you
agree that winning a conservative majority in the U.S. Senate is
vital to our nation's future, and if you're willing to engage in
these races even when the media ignores them, then please do two
things today.

(1)
Forward this email and encourage other conservatives to join our
grassroots effort to build a conservative Senate.

(2) Make
a split contribution to these candidates today. Without financial
support, they simply won't win.

Thank you
for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help
fight for America's future.

We live
in the greatest country in the world, and if we work together, we
can preserve it for generations to come.

ELECTION
COUNTDOWN

SENATE CONSERVATIVES

NOW

Hey everybody, One last friendly reminder: **today is the last day to register in advance to vote on Election Day**! Registering in advance will save you time if you’re planning to vote in person on Tuesday, November 5. [Check your registration status](https://votereedolson.us/l/OX43R1NgOwle) and make sure you’re good to go. Deadline is 11:59 p.m. tonight.
---
[ Am I Registered to Vote? ](https://votereedolson.us/l/QjdOqrd9kzR5)
---
If you’re already registered to vote, don’t forget [you can vote early right now](https://votereedolson.us/l/l9eGgmFZKfgG)! See the info below on how to vote early. **We need everyone to get out the vote to get us to victory this year!**
---
|
---
**🗳️ Early In Person**
---
All voters have the option to vote early in person. To cast your ballot in person, go to the following locations:
* **Beltrami County:** Auditor-Treasurer's Office (701 Minnesota Ave NW, Ste 220, Bemidji, MN 56601). Open Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
* **Lake of the Woods County** : Lake of the Woods Government Center (206 8th Ave SE, Baudette, MN 56623). Open Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

If your voter registration is current and active, you do not need to bring identification. Your voter registration is considered active if you were registered at least 21 days before Election Day and you have not moved or changed names since then. If you need to register or update your registration, or you have not voted in four years or more, you will need to show [proof of residence](https://votereedolson.us/l/bnsMyA3ZXyT1) before you vote.
---
**📬 Early by Mail**
---
To vote by mail, apply to have an absentee ballot mailed to you. Your returned ballot must be received by Election Day. Find out more and apply on the [Secretary of State’s website](https://votereedolson.us/l/sPPevDfrQHSo).
---
|
---
Thanks, as always, for your ongoing support. \- Reed Olson

---
| Statement from Amy Carnevale, Chair of the Massachusetts Republican Party, on Tonight's Senate Debate
---
---
| "Senator Elizabeth Warren is a menace--she embodies everything wrong with the extreme progressive movement and the corrosive division that is undermining our political system. Warren doesn't campaign on hope or unity, but rather on fear and anger, stoking resentment instead of offering real solutions. Instead of uniting Americans under one flag, she divides them by socioeconomic status, race, and sexuality, tearing further at the fabric of our nation.
But even more dangerous than her divisive rhetoric are her radical economic policies. Warren's reckless agenda would push the United States to the brink of socialism, threatening the very foundations of our freedom and prosperity. She is actively pursuing tax hikes on the middle class, and her obsession with President Trump runs so deep that she is willing to reverse successful policies--such as the Trump tax cuts--just to score political points.
Her troubling alliances are equally alarming. Warren continues to associate with anti-Semitic groups and refuses to disavow their dangerous agendas. On the anniversary of the October 7th attack on Israel, instead of offering sincere condolences to the victims and their families, she chose to focus much of her statement on criticizing Israel.
Meanwhile, Warren remains silent on the border crisis. Rather than risk backlash from the extreme progressive base she helped create, she avoids offering solutions--despite the fact that the crisis has disproportionately impacted Massachusetts more than many other states.
John Deaton offers a better way forward, rooted in pragmatic solutions and a genuine commitment to the people. Massachusetts has a unique opportunity to elect a leader who will prioritize the interests of the Commonwealth over partisan games. Tonight, residents will have the chance to meet John Deaton and hear his vision for a stronger, more united future."
###
The full debate will be streamed on CBS at 8:30 PM.

And yet from the unrest at the border to the failing economy, Harris has spent the past two months distancing herself from the havoc caused by the Biden Administration and positioning herself as the “change” candidate. After all of this gaslighting, last week, Harris had the gall to say she wouldn’t change a single Biden policy. clean_body: This year’s NC Supreme Court race will probably be decided by as little as 1% of the vote, and Justice Riggs can’t win it without you. | = Peter — The most baldly political high court in America isn’t the Trump-appointed group in Washington DC. It’s the far-right North Carolina Supreme Court that paved the way for radically gerrymandered maps and recently delayed our ballots to help Trump. And this Election Day, Republicans have the chance to move our state’s highest court even further to the right. Justice Allison Riggs, one of the few on the court we can trust to rule with fairness and integrity, is up against a GOP-backed judge trying to take her seat. = Justice Riggs was appointed to the NC Supreme Court by Governor Roy Cooper after 14 years as a civil rights litigator and a long career spent fighting for equal justice. She has proudly and faithfully served as the youngest woman on our state’s highest court. Justice Allison Riggs serves all North Carolinians, without fear or favor. She’s who we want on the bench as some of our state’s biggest cases are decided. But judicial elections like hers often go overlooked and underfunded. And Justice Riggs is locked in a tight race against yet another GOP lackey who could cast the deciding vote on cases related to our elections, schools, and reproductive freedom. | | Happy Tuesday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only __**THREE WEEKS**__ until Election Day. These last three weeks will decide not only the future of this District, but will determine if we hold our House Majority. The stakes couldn't be higher, and we need your help to make sure Tom Kean, Jr. is sent back to Congress. Thousands more vote-by-mail ballots have been returned since my last update. The Early Voting period begins in 11 days on October 26th. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain our momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. Thanks to your help, we out-walked and out-called our opponent's team for the third week in a row. Our opponent is running scared because she knows our grassroots team is strong. This past week, Tom was all over the district at local events, held meetings with constituents, participated in press interviews, and on Sunday Night took on our opponent head-to-head in the NJ07 New Jersey Globe Debate. Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. In the next three weeks, we will be expanding our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts ahead of Early Voting. We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. Anyone registered as a permanent vote-by-mail voter should have received their ballots by now. If you have any questions, please email [Info@TomKean.com](mailto:Info@TomKean.com "Info@TomKean.com"). If you recently requested a vote-by-mail ballot, it should be arriving shortly! Please make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections. You can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our [Voter Resources Page](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e7b8e6fe474f46c6be2139e8af3581bd&_e=ePB9HQlX1vSpymvINSZg8g3asSUI8dhsryK__fx9a5tjUHEEvlRWV0AMIsfhJPKczLZf_4Zxgi8zawH1agiVYcbGxB3CrlMrUqSXuOmHn3tTdOi91eSBMxRfMbNWSNNgnR8ruYaF_mxdkKCRvGnWy5ON0H6_P0PjS9crW2cxdrh4GFRqkCgrqxdXyCtlbFKFb7eJCRJFjIrFTCDKH1jGC1D6A4hB-gBnFD5vH3-w4ns%3D). _Please make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th_. Questions? [Click this link](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e7b8e6fe474f46c6be2139e8af3581bd&_e=ePB9HQlX1vSpymvINSZg8pdNtxdwJbPMBMY5vafsmEMt0MsBx4lGjmF-jzGKMPwHv_VxGRRt9Q3LgoemSaNrXTlaDdbtcpbYLF9p7X-76F6srO-mneivSvMhfXGxuESUdpjoQpGkKzuds1mcN01NfyZrpfb4-WNvUuDl743AdiV_ZjOHJ_mL4IKxk4NXaximsKCXKkrzKYoM3bX9NqzpXqljbghLLQx7R7xY1WCmIQG7IMrCl4k8HsvFiY5zdk1M). Next week, we will cover everything you need to know about in-person Early Voting, which is another great option to bank your vote early and run up the score. Early Voting begins October 26th through November 3rd. _**Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,[please visit our website](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e7b8e6fe474f46c6be2139e8af3581bd&_e=ePB9HQlX1vSpymvINSZg8mKZBie8TM8TZzxbe-OdDDP00t0OsmdRTBbzYEZbNz7ckfrtP0s7lOvZkgJpF3-_1ykVM9RuLpDsGtgh12HQEDc8k_EvpuuUxmPLrGUf5u99YgICOoyH9LuDG9bJDKiDFMfZI1NEOCLChSJdtyiPx2Td9ciuYrsPdhkJCLHOx5DmOS4nXLuQwdJPosVTqembZydqvtLttYvesg0y-ny45Gs%3D).**_ Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | **✅ Kean Visits FY25 Community Project Funding Site in Warren County ✅**
---
| | This past week, Tom continued his FY25 Community Project Funding Tour in Warren County. To address the urgent need for improvements at Warren Community College’s Agricultural Education and Training Center, Tom has requested $978,625 as part of this year's appropriation process. These funds would be dedicated to upgrading the center’s facilities, enhancing its ability to provide vocational training in agriculture and culinary studies for students.
_“This funding would provide students with the necessary resources and training in vocational agriculture and culinary studies, helping to foster skill development and workforce readiness in these fields.” _\- _**Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**_

| | Tom made stops this week to __**Lopatcong**__ for a candidate meet and greet, __**Somerville**__ for a Labor Launch with members of the Carpenters Union, __**Scotch Plains**__ for the Farmers Market, __**Phillipsburg**__ for the Pork Roll Palooza, __**Alpha**__ for their Fall Fest, and __**Basking Ridge**__ for the Dandiya festival, amongst other stops! Did you see see him at any stops? Send any pictures to our [email address](mailto:Info@TomKean.com "Info@TomKean.com"). Tom will continue to be all across the district this week speaking with voters and attending events. The Field Team started the first wave of our lawn sign blitz, scheduled major upcoming door launches, and activated new volunteers. They prepped walk lists for local candidates, and also prepared more resources for the upcoming labor walks we have. This past week, 60+ union members joined us to canvass all of Somerville in one morning. Their energy to get Tom re-elected was fantastic, are we are so proud to stand with labor on the campaign trail. If you or anyone you know is interested in stepping up to assist, please use the volunteer sign up link below to join the team. Our door knocking program covered towns like _**Flemington**_ , _**Raritan Township, Readington, Clinton Town, West Amwell, Tewksbury, Alexandria, Mount Olive, Long Hill, Berkeley Heights, Scotch Plains, Rahway, Springfield, Phillipsburg, Alpha, Pohatcong, Washington Borough, Washington Township, Oxford, Sparta, Byram, Ogdensburg, Hopatcong**_ , and **_Branchburg, Somerville, Bernardsville_** (just to name a few!). Hands down, this was our best week of voter contact since the primary, with thousands of doors knocked. We have a number of scheduled launches in the coming weeks, including with our partners in labor. We hope to see you there. Our weekly door goal is once again increasing significantly next week, and we must make sure we are doing everything we can to reach the voters we need to. [_Don't forget to click our sign-up link if you would like to join our door efforts in the coming weeks_.](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e7b8e6fe474f46c6be2139e8af3581bd&_e=ePB9HQlX1vSpymvINSZg8mKZBie8TM8TZzxbe-OdDDP00t0OsmdRTBbzYEZbNz7cy866IK115mVNMxxR4YUAfB6-Lhrf0_nBc82pkXu-r7uGRIFKCV_KX4Pnx_qYErmYG4XdhwP68LGwrxSjimThBz0Lj_DpCw4kmxltUhOfHhCjggA-BU0QAzHv4Fr8EJbndJeLKEOfmEvW2BSmKtldTTCxc1edVqE1qmpbx-Eaw2w%3D) Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with five organized phone banks this week - Union, Hunterdon, Warren and Somerset. This week we were able to call over __**16**_ _**__,5__ 00 voters**__ across all six counties. We spent much of the time chasing outstanding vote-by-mail ballots to be returned. We also sent out another __**90**_ _**,000+**__ text messages. Our plan and efforts are _**working**_ , as the AP reported that Republicans are returning their ballots at a higher level than in both 2020 and 2022 to this point. We now have a minimum of three to four phone banks a week that you can join from now until Election Day! Our county organizations launched their vote-by-mail chase efforts on phones this week. We will continue our texting banks - an easy way to get involved - to continue to put up points on the board. [_Don't forget to click our sign-up link if you would like to join our phone and texting banking efforts in the coming weeks_.](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e7b8e6fe474f46c6be2139e8af3581bd&_e=ePB9HQlX1vSpymvINSZg8mKZBie8TM8TZzxbe-OdDDP00t0OsmdRTBbzYEZbNz7chzyRbtrT3Ry-DvEWpGCJ5Vnp4glxMeQXVyvQhBjR1in_Dre8sLszkdVhlaHwUJ3mjGo5BdHNi2x4lOlbP09UGuIu8MQeZ3qErxykYL08LvI0btGmXtpSiWcbGA-uNmSTyod0OxY4NrAEtA2z6sKxI4jYXznPLo5PQicBDjzn-qc%3D) **Call for Volunteers!!** The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Tuesday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only THREE WEEKS until Election Day. These last three weeks will decide not only the future of this District, but will determine if we hold our House Majority. The stakes couldn't be higher, and we need your help to make sure Tom Kean, Jr. is sent back to Congress. Thousands more vote-by-mail ballots have been returned since my last update. The Early Voting period begins in 11 days on October 26th. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain our momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. Thanks to your help, we out-walked and out-called our opponent's team for the third week in a row. Our opponent is running scared because she knows our grassroots team is strong. This past week, Tom was all over the district at local events, held meetings with constituents, participated in press interviews, and on Sunday Night took on our opponent head-to-head in the NJ07 New Jersey Globe Debate. Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. In the next three weeks, we will be expanding our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts ahead of Early Voting. We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. Anyone registered as a permanent vote-by-mail voter should have received their ballots by now. If you have any questions, please email mailto:Info@TomKean.com "Info@TomKean.com". If you recently requested a vote-by-mail ballot, it should be arriving shortly! Please make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections. You can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our . Please make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th. Questions? . Next week, we will cover everything you need to know about in-person Early Voting, which is another great option to bank your vote early and run up the score. Early Voting begins October 26th through November 3rd. Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: Lawn signs are moving fast, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Visits FY25 Community Project Funding Site in Warren County ✅ | | This past week, Tom continued his FY25 Community Project Funding Tour in Warren County. To address the urgent need for improvements at Warren Community College’s Agricultural Education and Training Center, Tom has requested $978,625 as part of this year's appropriation process. These funds would be dedicated to upgrading the center’s facilities, enhancing its ability to provide vocational training in agriculture and culinary studies for students. “This funding would provide students with the necessary resources and training in vocational agriculture and culinary studies, helping to foster skill development and workforce readiness in these fields.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | Tom made stops this week to Lopatcong for a candidate meet and greet, Somerville for a Labor Launch with members of the Carpenters Union, Scotch Plains for the Farmers Market, Phillipsburg for the Pork Roll Palooza, Alpha for their Fall Fest, and Basking Ridge for the Dandiya festival, amongst other stops! Did you see see him at any stops? Send any pictures to our mailto:Info@TomKean.com "Info@TomKean.com". Tom will continue to be all across the district this week speaking with voters and attending events. The Field Team started the first wave of our lawn sign blitz, scheduled major upcoming door launches, and activated new volunteers. They prepped walk lists for local candidates, and also prepared more resources for the upcoming labor walks we have. This past week, 60+ union members joined us to canvass all of Somerville in one morning. Their energy to get Tom re-elected was fantastic, are we are so proud to stand with labor on the campaign trail. If you or anyone you know is interested in stepping up to assist, please use the volunteer sign up link below to join the team. Our door knocking program covered towns like Flemington , Raritan Township, Readington, Clinton Town, West Amwell, Tewksbury, Alexandria, Mount Olive, Long Hill, Berkeley Heights, Scotch Plains, Rahway, Springfield, Phillipsburg, Alpha, Pohatcong, Washington Borough, Washington Township, Oxford, Sparta, Byram, Ogdensburg, Hopatcong , and Branchburg, Somerville, Bernardsville (just to name a few!). Hands down, this was our best week of voter contact since the primary, with thousands of doors knocked. We have a number of scheduled launches in the coming weeks, including with our partners in labor. We hope to see you there. well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand

think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most

Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it

government.

today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because

on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63631033:sm79LPWND:m:3:2532013465:8FD5E32299DEF966B9C6BFA75D63B4D9:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

body:
Under Virginia law, election officials are required to challenge any voter who they suspect of being a non-citizen |
---
| |
---
| |
# **RITE Requests Virginia Elections Officials Take Action to Enforce State Laws that Protect Against Non-Citizen Voting**

(Richmond, Virginia – October 15, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization whose mission is to protect election integrity and ensure elections officials follow the law, has [written Virginia elections officials](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=fde6d5423c&e=ea91f782ea) requesting immediate action to stop Prince William County from ignoring a Virginia law that safeguards the Commonwealth’s elections from non-citizen voting.

Under Virginia law, election officials are required to challenge any voter who they suspect of being a non-citizen. Challenged individuals may still vote so long as they sign a statement affirming, under oath, that they are citizens.

Recently, however, Prince William County published an [operations manual](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=88de1523a2&e=ea91f782ea) that ignores this requirement. The Prince William County manual directs election officials to allow persons who present Driver Privilege Cards (“DPCs”), which are issued exclusively to non-citizens, to vote without challenge, so long as they also present some other form of identification. This is unlawful.

A person’s possession of a DPC is more than enough reason to suspect that he or she is a non-citizen. After all, a person must be a non-citizen to receive a DPC in the first place. Except for a United States passport, other forms of identification, including driver’s licenses, paychecks, bank statements, and utility bills, are not evidence that a person who possesses a DPC has become a citizen.

RITE has requested that Virginia election officials take immediate action to correct this situation in Prince William County by notifying the county of its obligation to challenge voters who present DPCs. It has also requested that she issue guidance to other counties to ensure they do not make a similar error.

“The Youngkin administration has made great progress in protecting Virginia’s elections from non-citizen voting. Undertaking the actions RITE has requested would further this work and give the Commonwealth’s citizens even more reason to have faith and trust in this year’s elections,” said Derek Lyons, President and CEO of RITE. “Virginia law is clear that election officials must challenge anyone suspected of being a non-citizen. When a person presents a document issued only to non-citizens, the only reasonable conclusion is to suspect that the person is not a citizen. Unless that person also presents a United States passport, election officials have a legal duty to require a signed, sworn statement attesting to citizenship before allowing that person to participate in the Commonwealth’s elections.”

When Donald Trump talks about the greatest threats to our nation, he’s not talking about Russia, or Iran. He’s not talking about North Korea or a resurgent, expansionist China.
#
_“We pledge to you that we will root out the communists, marxists, fascists and radical left thugs who live like vermin within the confines of our country... The threat from outside forces is far less sinister, dangerous, and grave than the threat from within.”_
**Donald Trump, November 11, 2023**
_“The bigger problem is the enemy from within... We have some very bad people, sick people, radical left lunatics, and I think it should be very easily handled by, if necessary by National Guard, or if really necessary by the Military, because they can’t let that happen.”_
**Donald Trump, October 12, 2024**
When Donald Trump talks about the greatest threats to our nation, he’s not talking about Russia, or Iran. He’s not talking about North Korea testing long range missiles, or an increasingly expansionist China.
He’s talking about you, Peter. He’s talking about the people who would dare to stand up to him at home, in the United States.
**“The threat from within” is us.**
This man is a fascist, through and through. We’ve seen his like before. He uses the same rhetoric, sometimes the same exact words and phrases, as men like Adolf Hitler and Benito Mussolini. And at this point, it’s fair to say that he shares many of their goals.
The last time men like Trump led some of the strongest militaries in the world, more than 65 million people were killed. 420,000 Americans died to stop him and the Axis Powers allied with him.
It does not have to go that far this time. Don’t let the polls convince you this is hopeless. Don’t let the pundits tell you that we’re doomed. We can stop Donald Trump at the ballot box, and we’ve got the tools we need to do it.
All we need is a final push these next three weeks. And to get the job done, we need you with us.

Any candidate wishing to publish an op-ed on our forum should make submissions to

Carris: The Border Crisis Comes to the Chicago Suburbs (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/the-border-crisis-comes-to-the-chicago-suburbs.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3b1740b16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/the-border-crisis-comes-to-the-chicago-suburbs.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3b1740b16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Republican nominee for Illinois' 10th congressional district, Jim Carris, right, and Yuma County Sheriff Leon N. Wilmot, in April 2024. (Photo: Carris for Congress)
By Jim Carris

The crisis at our southern border continues to impact communities across the nation, including right here in the Midwest and the 10th Congressional District. Local resources are stretched thin, security concerns are rising, and cities like Chicago are forced to deal with the consequences of federal inaction and partisan politics.

The Biden Administration’s refusal to address this issue has pushed local governments into a situation they can’t handle forcing them to manage an overwhelming influx of migrants and forcing nonprofits and social services to cover the gaps, all while diverting resources from veterans, seniors, and those most in need.

Schools are overcrowded with students requiring special attention, healthcare facilities are overwhelmed, and law enforcement struggles to maintain public safety amid increasing crime linked to illegal immigration.

This isn’t just a border state problem anymore—every state is now a border state.

To understand the issue better, I traveled to Yuma, Arizona, where I spoke with law enforcement, healthcare workers, and NGO leaders who are on the front lines. I’ve made it a priority to learn directly from experts and residents how this crisis is affecting our District.

What I witnessed was heartbreaking.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/the-border-crisis-comes-to-the-chicago-suburbs.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3b1740b16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
I saw personal belongings left behind by migrants—many of whom are victims of human trafficking. Meanwhile, over 6 million migrants have crossed the border under the Biden Administration, with 1.5 million untracked and unprocessed, posing a serious national security threat.

The cartels are profiting billions from Biden’s border chaos, forcing migrants, some with bad intentions, to pay for entry and then demanding a portion of their wages once they’re in the U.S. The national security implications of this are immeasurable and it undermines America’s role on the global stage.

Like so many Democrats, my opponent Brad Schneider refuses to do anything. He hasn’t visited the border since 2019.

His website and social media are filled with announcements and photo-ops, but none of them address how this influx of migrants is affecting our District.

Silence would be bad enough, but he is making things worse. Last month, he voted against the Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act, which would have provided protection for women and imposed severe penalties on offenders, particularly those here illegally, and against the Detain and Deport Illegal Aliens Who Assault Cops Act.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/the-border-crisis-comes-to-the-chicago-suburbs.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3b1740b16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

I’ve seen the impact on our community firsthand, and I’ve taken the time to learn from both residents and experts. Few congressional representatives have been as silent on this issue as my opponent.

Americans deserve a government that prioritizes their needs and keeps us safe. That requires a secure border and a fair and compassionate immigration policy.

President Biden must end his open-border policy immediately, and we need strong, courageous leaders who will hold him accountable.

That is why I am running.

Jim Carris is the Republican candidate for Congress in Illinois’ 10th District. To learn more about his vision for a strong, safe, and growing America visit CarrisforCongress.com (https://carrisforcongress.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3b1740b16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/669034/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/669034/]

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2062%2E135344%2EjjbYgO)

Last week, Donald Trump spoke in Detroit at the Detroit Economic Club. It was billed as an opportunity to present a series of plans to bolster the American auto industry, a topic that a lot of Michiganders are interested in.
But that’s not what we saw. Instead in the *2 hours* that Trump spoke, he aired personal grievances, lied about Michigan election laws, lied about having been named “Michigan Man of the Year,” and repeatedly insulted the great city of Detroit.
Absolutely not.
But the bigger message was not his words, but his actions. Trump’s repeated presence here in Michigan over and over and over again is the clearest signal of all.
Trump knows what we know: If he loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups have already spent or committed more than $50 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers.
And our state is virtually tied — recent public polls show a dead heat for both the presidential and the Senate race, Cook Political Report has our race rated as a pure toss-up, and the nonpartisan election forecasters have said there may be no state more important in the presidential race than Michigan.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
[**We can't let that happen. Want to help? Chip in what you can and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump. clean_body: Last week, Donald Trump spoke in Detroit at the Detroit Economic Club. It was billed as an opportunity to present a series of plans to bolster the American auto industry, a topic that a lot of Michiganders are interested in. But that’s not what we saw. Instead in the 2 hours that Trump spoke, he aired personal grievances, lied about Michigan election laws, lied about having been named “Michigan Man of the Year,” and repeatedly insulted the great city of Detroit. Absolutely not. But the bigger message was not his words, but his actions. Trump’s repeated presence here in Michigan over and over and over again is the clearest signal of all. Trump knows what we know: If he loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well. That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups have already spent or committed more than $50 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers. And our state is virtually tied — recent public polls show a dead heat for both the presidential and the Senate race, Cook Political Report has our race rated as a pure toss-up, and the nonpartisan election forecasters have said there may be no state more important in the presidential race than Michigan. The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day. | | Peter, I want to tell you the story about someone very dear to me: my grandmother, Sarah Daisy. She was a single mom, who worked as a housekeeper to provide a one-bedroom apartment for my Dad and his two siblings. She had a dream of one day working for the federal government, but at the time you had to pass a typing test. She didn’t know how to type, and she couldn’t afford a typewriter. It would have been easy to have given up on her dream, but she was determined to get a good job and provide a better life for her kids. So after working all day, she would get out a piece of paper and draw a typewriter to hang on the refrigerator, and taught herself the keystrokes. She eventually passed the test, and got the job. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32585?t=9&amount=25&akid=2918%2E52803%2ERrvE-A) Women like my grandmother cracked open the door of opportunity so that future generations of women, like me, could kick it down. **It’s not lost on me that Maryland has _never_ had a Black senator, and _only_ 3 Black women have ever served in the United States Senate.** But hard work runs through my blood, and just like my grandmother, I am working every day to win this race and ensure a better future for the next generation. **But I can’t do this alone — this race is bigger than just me because the Senate majority is on the line, and with it, the power to chart a brighter future for Maryland, and a better future for our country.[That’s why I’m personally asking: Will you donate $25 or more to help me make history, win this race, and defend the Senate majority? ](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32585?t=10&amount=25&akid=2918%2E52803%2ERrvE-A)** _If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately._ | | | [Chip in $25](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32585?t=11&express_lane=true&amount=25&akid=2918%2E52803%2ERrvE-A)

body:

As the upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the
Bible to guide our decisions?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osPnyAPWNN

Dear
Friend,

Politics
often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many
of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging,
pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll
numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem
like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as
Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture
or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The
Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians
3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter
2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to
unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems
transitory at best?

The
answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of
the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to
preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God
has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our
culture-entertainment, business, education, and yes, even
government.

As the
upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the Bible to
guide our decisions? In my new 44-page booklet, How a Christian
Should Vote, I offer a biblical framework for assessing
candidates, their faith, policies, and constitutional views. This
practical resource will help you view the election from a
biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.

There are
4 main questions that a Christian should be asking themselves
before casting a vote:

Is
the candidate a Christian?
Do
the candidate's policies align with the Bible?
What
is the candidate's view of Israel?
Will
the candidate get things done?

You
can receive a free copy of How a Christian Should Vote in time
for the elections by clicking here:
https://ptv.org/nna/how-a-christian-should-vote-by-dr-robert-jeffress-2024/

Together, we can determine the direction of our country by voting
for leaders who will embrace principles that bring God's favor
upon our nation.

In
Christ,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress

P.S.
Jesus commanded us to be salt and light in this world. Through
the ministry of Pathway to Victory, we are using the most
effective media available-television, radio, print, and
digital-to spread the Gospel! Request your free copy of How a
Christian Should Vote today and join us in making a difference.

Friend, I want to personally thank you for always standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95069651/505488509/-862660935?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5506-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTYyOTc2OC0xMzhiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NrDaf_Nz09DdRx7IoU-QjR--xe2NYfvPbPMZrkugfXY=)
Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.

If your inbox is anything like mine, it is absolutely overflowing with emails asking for a donation before our final, pre-election FEC fundraising deadline hits on Wednesday.
I’ve got to apologize, because I’m about to join them.

That's the scoop, according to The Hill

| | |

|
---
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|

body:
Pitch in while you still can. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4caf0c1ef134/we-need-a-montana-state-auditor-who-you-can-trust-7226497?e=9ec0a0596f)

#
---
| The right to privacy has been one that has been trampled in countless states across the nation over the past several years. In Montana, we can’t afford to let that happen. We have a Constitutional right to privacy guaranteed in the Montana State Constitution.
**To cut to the chase, I’m working to defend privacy rights as Montana’s auditor, and I need your help to do it.**
---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=6af55e2ce8&e=9ec0a0596f)
| **As the State Auditor, there’s more than you’d think to be done regarding the privacy rights of Montanans.**
I’ll defend the privacy rights of Montanas by keeping the government and insurance companies out of your doctor’s office and out of your bedroom, ensuring that every Montanan -- women especially -- is trusted to make their medical and personal decisions without government intervention.
---
[ACT NOW](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=ddd72babc8&e=9ec0a0596f)
| This should be a no-brainer, and it’s why I’m happy to be a pro-privacy candidate. To win though, and preserve privacy in Montana, I’m going to need your help. Our competition is raising countless dollars off the backs of corporate donors and [**out-of-state interests. I need you to chip in today if we’re to match them and put up a fight in November.**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=32c3f5f206&e=9ec0a0596f)
Our privacy hangs in the balance. Can I count on you?
**Best,**

| | | | Friends, Environmental conservation and our national security go hand in hand.

The loss of nature contributes to instability by [creating vacuums for crime, violence, and war](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ffb4d76cbc&e=33f53a5b1a) and adversaries are working to exploit natural resources around the world for their financial gain.

**We must put a stop to it. ** To combat this, With Honor Action and members of the [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=c2d8c85f38&e=33f53a5b1a), including Co-Chairs Rep. Jason Crow and Rep. Tony Gonzales and Foreign Affairs Africa Subcommittee Chair Rep John James, are advancing the [US Foundation for International Conservation Act (USFICA)](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=e42bd64ad6&e=33f53a5b1a). This bipartisan bill would establish the U.S. Foundation for International Conservation, which through a public-private partnership, would raise around $2 billion to support worldwide conservation efforts. The effort also includes a coalition of other stakeholders such as Conservation International and the Congressional Sportsmen's Foundation.

The USFICA would significantly improve national, regional, and global security by investing in conservation efforts, making it more difficult for bad actors to exploit the environment for their own nefarious purposes and we’ve been making it a priority in Congress.

To build momentum for this bill to pass in this year’s National Defense Authorization Act, we held a special briefing on Capitol Hill last week with former U.S. House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman, Ed Royce, along with members of the U.S. Department of State, notable Congressional staff, and Conservation International.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: want to see what your donations have been up to?
body:
Hey Peter,

What is the most important thing pro-lifers can do right now to stop the Abortion Lobby from seizinpg TOTAL control of Washington, D.C. and state capitals across the country in November?

Is it exposing their extreme pro-abortion agenda to potential voters through hard-hitting ad campaigns?

What about converting pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people to the Pro-Life Movement?

Could it be fighting radical pro-abortion referendums by reaching out to and registering new pro-life voters and making sure they Vote Pro-Life First?

There isn’t a single clear-cut answer, Peter . . .

But whatever answer you thought of, Students for Life Action is doing it!

And I’d like to share with you a few details on everything your generous support for Students for Life Action is enabling us to do!

Door-Knocking in Battleground States

There’s no substitute for face-to-face conversations when it comes to winning hearts and minds for the pro-life cause.

That’s why Students for Life Action has been hard at work sending volunteers door-knocking in key districts in Battleground and Referendum States!

Recently we’ve had canvassers lead successful deployment campaigns in Arizona, Michigan, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, and South Dakota.

And in the coming weeks we’ll be deploying even MORE students to Florida – so they can educate voters in the Sunshine State about the radical Amendment 4 abortion referendum – as well as Missouri, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SYB1BHAS2JcQo-vm6Q2ETw~~/AAVkMwA~
These canvassers are our student activists who serve everyday on their campuses and now they are putting in VERY long, hard days of work on the weekends in their communities!

The truth is, it’s not easy knocking on doors, informing voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes even being attacked by pro-abortion radicals that they encounter.

One student in Arizona, Juan, encountered a confrontational older man who even cursed at him for being pro-life.

Juan remained calm, polite, and even eventually convinced him to vote NO on Arizona’s radical abortion referendum, Proposition 139!

Another student in Michigan, Mataya, had the COPS called on her by an angry pro-abortion radical, only for her to have a conversion with the policeman and hand him some election materials!

He even told Mataya to keep up the good work!

Texting On-the-Fence Voters

Our students don’t just change hearts and minds while they’re door-knocking though.

They also send texts to voters and have conversations with them that way!

In fact, recently I got sent some photos of a few students heading to Arizona all the way from California – a SIX-hour drive for them!

And while they were on the way, they spent every second they could sending text messages.

These students know just how important it is to win in every Battleground and Referendum State we can to defeat the Abortion Lobby in 2024 – and they’re willing to spare no effort to make sure that happens!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Az5lKb4GNDO0N0O1YnWQog~~/AAVkMwA~

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TsW8G0EChH96TL7ayfQNJQ~~/AAVkMwA~

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/XQhdREMS1gA3GPGz1eKbLg~~/AAVkMwA~

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/DllhkzOtFsk_8KF_AaGEig~~/AAVkMwA~

2024 Referendum Battleplan

The Abortion Lobby is on the attack with no less than SEVEN pro-abortion ballot initiatives this year in states like:

- Arizona

- Nebraska

- Missouri

- Montana

- Florida

- South Dakota

The good news is, thanks to your support, Students for Life Action is fighting back.

With your help, our dedicated student activists are conducting critical voter outreach programs using key election materials to turn out the pro-life vote! Materials like:

- Ballot Referendum Kits – which we’re using to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

- Yard Signs – which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide!

These are just some of what we use to turn voters against the Abortion Lobby’s attempts to pass vaguely written, dangerous pro-abortion ballot initiatives.

Though none of the tools would have the heart and mind changing power that they do without our dedicated student leaders handing them out while having conversations with folks!

Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour

We have several tours going on right now – some localized and some national – that are getting pro-lifers involved in this critical election fight and even gaining media attention.

But our Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour, which just wrapped up on October 2nd was arguably our biggest and most successful!

On this tour, our state-of-the-art Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck screened the pro-life movie, Unplanned, on dozens of college campuses in SEVEN hotly contested states that WILL decide 2024, including:

- Arizona*

- Montana*

- Florida*

- North Carolina

- Michigan

- Pennsylvania

- Missouri*

*Abortion ballot referendum state

Unplanned is one of the most powerful tools the Pro-Life Movement has right now at turning young people against abortion, as many pro-abortion/on-the-fence students who watch it have their eyes opened on the evils of abortion.

At every screening, we reached and converted hundreds of pro-abortion young people.

But we didn’t just screen the movie, pack up, and leave.

We also ensured every pro-lifer on these campuses is registered to vote, urged them to join their campus group, promised to watch Unplanned with at least one pro-abortion friend, and pledged to “Vote Pro-Life First” in November.

Then, as Election Day nears, we’ll contact them again to follow through on their pledges.

I believe this project could prove to be one of the most critical Students for Life Action has ever conducted – seeing as these young people will be the key to winning in 2024.

Just one example of the impact this tour had would be at the University of Nebraska, where we showed Unplanned to dozens of students – including many who had never seen the movie before and even several who were walking by and had questions.

Then we followed that up with a deployment (pictured below) encouraging voters to Vote No on Initiative Measure 439.

Some of the students who watched the movie even joined us!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jhZYp9gxDbIZngkH4RB8dA~~/AAVkMwA~

Election Year Media Campaign

Over the last few weeks, we’ve launched not one, but TWO hard-hitting commercials to EXPOSE Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz for their insane, late-term abortion-on-demand agenda.

The first of these two ads we plastered all over the internet and targeted key voting-age young people on social media sites like YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.

You can watch it by clicking here:
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/n_e9jAfgavZxMqohI46WGg~~/AAVkMwA~
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t9Zlr9T-GHZ5AhRjYmil4Q~~/AAVkMwA~

The second of these two ads was even BIGGER than the first as we ran it on the Fox News and Fox Business channels for nearly a week, garnering almost 50 MILLION views over that period.

Not only that, but we also ran the ad LIVE on Fox News during the Vice-Presidential Debate between J.D. Vance and Gov. Tim Walz.

During the debate, Fox News had the highest ratings among the competitive cable news set with 7.97 million viewers, and Fox News Media — which produces the Fox network coverage and simulcast the debate on Fox News and Fox Business — saw a collective audience of around 10.67 million viewers, the Nielsen data showed.

In other words, in only a roughly two-hour span, over 10 and a half MILLION people saw this add:
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Ooc0_pfUPICLif26i6KZ9w~~/AAVkMwA~~~
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t6AVD82wpHl81NOw9xHV5Q~~/AAVkMwA~~~

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/gCWIz1NFLqv9vGY9X-ZuIw~~/AAVkMwA~~~

Moving Forward

I hope after reading through all the programs and efforts Students for Life Action has going on right now, you’re confident that your continued support for our work is your best chance of having an impact for Life in America – especially heading into these critical elections.

I also hope you can continue your support for Students for Life Action’s work by doing two things:

First: Pray – Pray for me, our staff, our students, and for our nation as we head into the coming weeks that we can be successful holding the line against the Abortion Lobby with these programs.

Second: Give –
Your generous contribution will ensure I have the funds I need to continue running these programs at full steam up until Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/H6kO8E3mVE9ivBakckwh-w~~/AAVkMwA~
!

Thank you for reading my update for you, Peter.

And thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – I forgot to include our Petition Deliveries, where we collect and send thousands of signed pro-life petitions to your elected officials in Washington, D.C. to make sure they hear our voices and stand up to the Abortion Lobby.

In fact, here’s a picture of our most recent petition delivery to Republican Congressman Chip Roy (TX-21) last month where our students delivered petitions and had a productive conversation on the Pro-Life Movement’s next steps after the November Elections!

clean_body: Hey Peter, What is the most important thing pro-lifers can do right now to stop the Abortion Lobby from seizinpg TOTAL control of Washington, D.C. and state capitals across the country in November? Is it exposing their extreme pro-abortion agenda to potential voters through hard-hitting ad campaigns? What about converting pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people to the Pro-Life Movement? Could it be fighting radical pro-abortion referendums by reaching out to and registering new pro-life voters and making sure they Vote Pro-Life First? There isn’t a single clear-cut answer, Peter . . . But whatever answer you thought of, Students for Life Action is doing it! And I’d like to share with you a few details on everything your generous support for Students for Life Action is enabling us to do! Door-Knocking in Battleground States There’s no substitute for face-to-face conversations when it comes to winning hearts and minds for the pro-life cause. That’s why Students for Life Action has been hard at work sending volunteers door-knocking in key districts in Battleground and Referendum States! Recently we’ve had canvassers lead successful deployment campaigns in Arizona, Michigan, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, and South Dakota. And in the coming weeks we’ll be deploying even MORE students to Florida – so they can educate voters in the Sunshine State about the radical Amendment 4 abortion referendum – as well as Missouri, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania! These canvassers are our student activists who serve everyday on their campuses and now they are putting in VERY long, hard days of work on the weekends in their communities! The truth is, it’s not easy knocking on doors, informing voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes even being attacked by pro-abortion radicals that they encounter. One student in Arizona, Juan, encountered a confrontational older man who even cursed at him for being pro-life. Juan remained calm, polite, and even eventually convinced him to vote NO on Arizona’s radical abortion referendum, Proposition 139! Another student in Michigan, Mataya, had the COPS called on her by an angry pro-abortion radical, only for her to have a conversion with the policeman and hand him some election materials! He even told Mataya to keep up the good work! Texting On-the-Fence Voters Our students don’t just change hearts and minds while they’re door-knocking though. They also send texts to voters and have conversations with them that way! In fact, recently I got sent some photos of a few students heading to Arizona all the way from California – a SIX-hour drive for them! And while they were on the way, they spent every second they could sending text messages. These students know just how important it is to win in every Battleground and Referendum State we can to defeat the Abortion Lobby in 2024 – and they’re willing to spare no effort to make sure that happens! 2024 Referendum Battleplan The Abortion Lobby is on the attack with no less than SEVEN pro-abortion ballot initiatives this year in states like: - Arizona - Nebraska - Missouri - Montana - Florida - South Dakota The good news is, thanks to your support, Students for Life Action is fighting back. Materials like: - Ballot Referendum Kits – which we’re using to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country! - Yard Signs – which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide! Then, as Election Day nears, we’ll contact them again to follow through on their pledges. I believe this project could prove to be one of the most critical Students for Life Action has ever conducted – seeing as these young people will be the key to winning in 2024. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Multiple major and gut-wrenching updates on Israel’s genocide and ethnic
cleansing in Gaza came out over the weekend,
Peter.

First, late last week a UN inquiry found that the Israeli government
purposefully targeted and destroyed Gaza’s healthcare infrastructure over
the past year, which constitutes a war crime. Remember when Western media
and the U.S. government denied Israel would ever bomb a hospital last
October?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241015-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241015-36070&akid=36070%2E1203867%2EhtCiQh ]Al Jazeera: BREAKING: A UN inquiry found that Israel implemented a
concerted policy to destroy Gaza’s healthcare system during its attacks,
which constitutes war crimes and the crime against humanity of
extermination.

Second, the Netanyahu administration told Haaretz that it is no longer
pursuing talks to free the hostages, and is instead planning to withhold
humanitarian aid — more than it already has for the last year, leaving
millions of Palestinians at risk of starvation — and annex portions of
Gaza. Any of the hundreds of thousands of Palestinian civilians who remain
in northern Gaza will be starved or killed.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241015-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241015-36070&akid=36070%2E1203867%2EhtCiQh ]Haaretz.com: Netanyahu’s government is not seeking to revive hostage
talks and the political leadership is pushing for the gradual annexation
of large parts of the Gaza Strip, senior defense officials tell Haaretz.
Assal Rad: He’s not “examining a plan,  no aid has gone in since Oct 1.
It’s not starving “out Hamas,” it’s starving civilians including children.
It’s not a plan that “could trap,” 400,000 people are already trapped with
nowhere to go. You’re supposed to cover war crimes not cover them up. The
Associated Press: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is examining a
plan to seal off humanitarian aid to northern Gaza in an attempt to starve
out Hamas militants, a plan that could trap hundreds of thousands of
Palestinians without food or water.

Third, the Israeli military bombed refugee tents outside of a hospital on
Sunday, burning children and other Palestinian patients alive — some
visibly hooked up to IVs and trapped in their beds. The images documenting
this cruel attack are nothing short of horrifying and will be an appalling
document of this genocide forever.

So what is the Biden Administration doing about it? It’s violating
international law by continuing to send BILLIONS of dollars in bombs and
weapons to Israel, and even sending U.S. troops to assist the Israeli
military, despite mounting evidence of Israel’s war crimes.

The United States is complicit in genocide and ethnic cleansing, and it
cannot continue, Peter. Israel
has violated international law repeatedly and will continue to do so until
Palestinians are completely wiped out, as long as the U.S. enables them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241015-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241015-36070&akid=36070%2E1203867%2EhtCiQh ]We have three words for the Biden Administration: Stop. Arming. Israel.
Add your name to demand an immediate arms embargo to stop this
annihilation NOW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241015-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241015-36070&akid=36070%2E1203867%2EhtCiQh ]Add Your Name

We cannot look away or become complacent,
Peter. Our elected officials are enabling and
our tax dollars are funding this genocide. We must keep speaking up until
our leaders change course and hold Israel accountable for these crimes
against humanity.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: Jim Jordan the JERK - Listen to this former waitress tell her story
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I’ve got a story that you HAVE to hear. One that tells you everything you need to know about Jim Jordan.
Recently, while stopping for lunch on the campaign trail, I struck up a conversation with a woman named Gabby.
Like so many students, Gabby waited tables while pursuing her education. One evening, she had the unfortunate job of serving Jim Jordan. I’ll let her tell you what happened next:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_image1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_image1]
That’s right! Jim Jordan actually POINTED at Gabby and said to the young people at his table: "Stay in school and work hard, so you don’t end up like that.”
Hang on! There’s more!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_image2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_image2]
“This is while I was an undergrad and had just gotten a full ride into a PhD program. So, he doesn’t know much. ”
While she was working hard to build her future, Jim Jordan belittled her and mocked her work ethic. His attacks on women are relentless.
Gabby’s right – Jim Jordan doesn’t know much.
We know the GOP fear women. They fear us because they fear losing power. They know women make more than 50% of the population. That’s why they are trying to send us barefoot and pregnant back to the kitchen.
OH, HELL NO!!
It’s time we send a message to Jim Jordan. Let’s show him his days of looking down on the rest of us are OVER. We just raised $2 MILLION to fire Jim Jordan. If we get to $3M we can DOUBLE our ad blitz. Rush a donation now and join the fight to FIRE Jim Jordan! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_link1]
Of course, this isn’t just an isolated incident. I’m out in the district all the time. As a small business owner, I know the hard work that goes into running and building your own business, so I try to support local shops. And as a total foodie I especially love visiting mom and pop restaurants around our beautiful district.
Over and over again, I hear stories like this about Jim Jordan from the people who have waited on him.
He’s rude, condescending, and he doesn’t even TIP.
Jim Jordan consistently looks down on all of us and acts like he’s better than us. That’s what decades of corruption and ladder climbing will get you.
How dare he put down someone working to pay their bills and get an education when he doesn’t even do his own job?!
Jim Jordan has been in Congress for 17 years and hasn’t authored and passed a single bill into law.
He’s the very definition of a pig-headed, lazy, elitist politician.
The bottom line is Jim Jordan is a JERK – and WE DESERVE BETTER!
People across the country are waking up to the idea that this is the most important congressional race in the country.
We have a chance to kick out a man who disrespects everyday Ohioans and replace him with someone who values and fights for our community.
To do that, we need two things – resources and volunteers.
If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]
But if you’re short on time, the BEST way to help is with a donation. We only have 21 days left until Election Day to reach every voter and expose Jordan for the disrespectful woman-hating fraud he truly is. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_jordan_the_jerk_button]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

body:

---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=7d6b1312dd974b00a27318022189a250&_e=6NhedVFMXwlqGxR4Gh4a9XzZufHennbZPhx_aQHUV75dqifPbnCPfX0pMM6JNN1ikbRQ7b_6V51254HgrtHO66l6ixL5J6FfiwinPOssYFX-hxRMtgCQYkn53Q8rZrVhxsLNXGdrwSz20xsHWfksH1AfwkQKnLdzN7fG61jUPV9UZ_bvFwI8zKN9Rq_bkvKWWC9v4aBXO6IjV_ggwYFYDDwv9sznpqzyCnn4_7DssP3i51VthdK9pXbSmjjRF18-UDmzXaiBQXxiY3_TuRl9yr1XqODjZ7mpW1F-NDunP2qEeQBQ6RYHAr244WcoyNd1egrx_XN_HLfr3J98ghWehia4Mg6FjLVcbuhae2UTodz1IySXXpumeoBQUwTQ8-SOWLwJK0GcC8RG_tqy_5Gwh8ZMfs8NtVW_Ys4R5_STdeTzVRxsJTKyCvLWiM5Bq2JJ) [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=7d6b1312dd974b00a27318022189a250&_e=6NhedVFMXwlqGxR4Gh4a9XzZufHennbZPhx_aQHUV75dqifPbnCPfX0pMM6JNN1ikbRQ7b_6V51254HgrtHO66l6ixL5J6FfiwinPOssYFX-hxRMtgCQYkn53Q8rZrVhxsLNXGdrwSz20xsHWfksH1AfwkQKnLdzN7fG61jUPV9UZ_bvFwI8zKN9Rq_bkvKWWC9v4aBXO6IjV_ggwYFYDDwv9sznpqzyCnn4_7DssP3i51VthdK9pXbSmjjRF18-UDmzXaiBQXxiY3_TuRl9ylSbWcHfR_dTJ1wLd9mDM2OmFQexA6rSLIuHhloY2h-b-zKVyR3J82HJR06TGVb9LCl6m30-86IEFIXQFUyNpfxGFtLfl-z_l4CxtGgp4-2BjhiE0zlY89yrzsFMn-iUE-7551JoioaItYSZPfLjOFZAvD8MBEUk-k_WVSWVsFiZ) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=7d6b1312dd974b00a27318022189a250&_e=6NhedVFMXwlqGxR4Gh4a9XzZufHennbZPhx_aQHUV75dqifPbnCPfX0pMM6JNN1ikbRQ7b_6V51254HgrtHO66l6ixL5J6FfiwinPOssYFX-hxRMtgCQYkn53Q8rZrVhxsLNXGdrwSz20xsHWfksH1AfwkQKnLdzN7fG61jUPV9UZ_bvFwI8zKN9Rq_bkvKWWC9v4aBXO6IjV_ggwYFYDDwv9sznpqzyCnn4_7DssP3i51VthdK9pXbSmjjRF18-UDmzXaiBQXxiY3_TuRl9yjaOclS6k5XJLqTbF3dzek75f7QIH9T_gDwTj8dQFzrC07RZg0tFcdAAH6D8TV18ZHJ3voYpIFqp4LNzhRj3nSoA8RmWc08lK0eh9V3Z51UfUKiFLzDN30Q6FlGdFw83B-EV58kieUcodVQHPZo714jZ_jh-aCfYVwRvMH4TcbDd)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith. Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed. This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life. Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith? body:
It’s time to show him up.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81991?t=6&akid=17467%2E878179%2ETnlsvM) Folks, later today I’ll be stepping onto the stage to debate Ted Cruz for the first time. **I have been waiting for this moment since my campaign began.**

I know exactly how his actions – and inactions – have hurt not just Texans, but every American.

From his trip to Cancun during a deadly winter freeze to being responsible for Texas' abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest or health of the mother, Ted Cruz can run, but he can’t hide from his extreme record.

[Before I take the debate stage tonight, will you show that you'll be standing with me by chipping in a split donation of $10 or anything you can between me and the Voter Protection Project to make sure that we have what it will take to defeat Cruz on November 5th?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81991?t=7&akid=17467%2E878179%2ETnlsvM) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Colin Allred and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81992?t=8&akid=17467%2E878179%2ETnlsvM)

[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81995?t=11&akid=17467%2E878179%2ETnlsvM)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81991?t=12&akid=17467%2E878179%2ETnlsvM)
Let’s compare our records.

I support a woman’s fundamental right to make her own health care decisions about her own body. **Ted Cruz thinks he and other politicians should be able to make those decisions for you. But a doctor’s office is way too cramped when Ted Cruz is in the room with you.**

I support safeguarding our democracy, one that not only listens to the people, but also serves the people. **Cruz tried overturning the free and fair 2020 election.**

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4c17e07b-4d1c-4d9b-859c-ba413e85932f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
