I have been waiting for this moment since my campaign began. I know exactly how his actions – and inactions – have hurt not just Texans, but every American. From his trip to Cancun during a deadly winter freeze to being responsible for Texas' abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest or health of the mother, Ted Cruz can run, but he can’t hide from his extreme record. [Before I take the debate stage tonight, will you show that you'll be standing with me by chipping in a split donation of $10 or anything you can between me and Blue Amp Action to make sure that we have what it will take to defeat Cruz on November 5th?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7b1d9ebd-f2a4-4556-87e8-0cf02625f34b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Let’s compare our records. I support a woman’s fundamental right to make her own health care decisions about her own body. Ted Cruz thinks he and other politicians should be able to make those decisions for you. But a doctor’s office is way too cramped when Ted Cruz is in the room with you. I support safeguarding our democracy, one that not only listens to the people, but also serves the people. Cruz tried overturning the free and fair 2020 election. But here's the deal: Cruz and the deep-pocketed extremist super PACs propping up his campaign recently funneled $34 million into attack ads to crush the momentum behind our movement and defeat me. So with less than 21 days until Election Day, we absolutely must reach our $2 million goal before our final FEC public filing deadline – or we might not have enough resources to fight back against the GOP spending flooding into this race. [That's why, before I step on the stage, I have to urgently ask you: Will you chip in a split donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action and help us hit our fundraising goal, win in Texas, and keep the Senate blue?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te7b4f2ea-e418-4d32-b89b-a816b685605f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It means so much to have you by my side. Thank you. – Colin

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

| | | **Stand Up for Parents ' Rights – **
**Support Our Campaign****!**
---

Dear Peter,
Parents are the primary caretakers of their children. That's why we passed the parents' rights initiative in Washington State this year. However, it's troubling that when a national parents' rights bill was allowed, Kim Schrier voted against it. She also voted against protecting our children's information from being sold for commercial or financial gains.

More than ever, it’s critical that we stand together to protect the rights of parents to make decisions for their children’s education, health, and upbringing. Parents should have a voice in what their children are taught in schools, and they deserve transparency from the government when it comes to the policies that affect their families.

Our campaign is committed to fighting for the rights of parents. We believe that families—not bureaucrats—know what’s best for their children. That’s why we’re working to pass policies that ensure curriculum transparency and empower parents to take control of their children’s education.
It’s time we have a Congresswoman willing to fight for our parents.

---

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE Sues Montgomery County, Pennsylvania for Illegal Lack of Transparency in Deploying Voter Services Van
body:
County failed to follow state law when debuting its voter services van |
---
| |
---
| |
## **RITE Sues Montgomery County, Pennsylvania for Illegal Lack of Transparency in Deploying Voter Services Van**

(Norristown, Pennsylvania – October 15, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization which supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today [sued Montgomery County, Pennsylvania](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=784bcd0c84&e=ea91f782ea) for failing to follow state law when debuting its voter services van. Pennsylvania law requires counties to post notices of the exact times and locations of their voter registration efforts at both the county’s main office and the location where it will be registering voters. This public notice provision ensures, among other things, that all residents have equal access to the county’s voter resources and that the counties act transparently. Earlier this month, Montgomery County, Pennsylvania introduced Pennsylvania’s first “Voter Services Mobile Satellite Office”—a van owned by Montgomery County that roves around the suburban Philadelphia county to serve as a location where residents can register to vote, request absentee ballots, and drop off absentee ballots all in one place, at one time. According to one county official, the van will even travel to voter’s addresses to allow them to cure their defective absentee ballots. But the county has so far failed to comply with legal requirements that prohibit counties from conducting registration activities at unannounced locations. “In Montgomery County’s race to deploy its first-of-its-kind voting van, it forgot about one crucial thing: state law,” said Derek Lyons, President and CEO of RITE. “A hallmark of good election administration is transparency, and that is why Pennsylvania’s legislature has required counties to notify the public regarding their voter registration activities. Ignoring state law so the county can register voters, give and receive absentee ballots, and allow voters to cure defective ballots all beyond view of the public sows distrust in our elections. If Montgomery County is to continue with these activities, it must comply with the public notice rules required by law.” ###

subject: Milton Friedman’s Bold Analysis of Government Intervention
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Friend,

Do you feel like the policy solutions offered by the government
often create more problems than they solve?

From education to healthcare and beyond, it's clear that good
intentions don't always lead to good outcomes.

That's why I'm excited to share a free digital copy of Milton
Friedman's thought-provoking eBook, "Why Government Is the
Problem."

In this insightful read, Friedman dives deep into:

Unveiling how government interventions can worsen the
social and economic problems they're trying to fix.

Revealing the influence of special interests in
policymaking, often at the expense of everyday citizens.

Explaining why limiting government involvement might be the
key to solving our most pressing challenges.

It's a must-read for anyone curious about the impact of
government actions on our society. Originally written in 1993,
Friedman's analysis remains as relevant today as ever.

Are you ready to explore a new perspective? Click here to get
your free copy of "Why Government Is the Problem" now.

Greg

clean_body: Please read this full message Fellow Patriot, At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record. And what's worse, they are doing it all because I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate. Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end. I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania. I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor. Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement. I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it. I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Fellow Patriot. We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me. I hate asking for money -- I'm not a career politician, and it's not in my nature -- but I have no choice but to ask if we're going to hit our fundraising goal for the final stretch of the campaign. Chuck Schumer and his allies are working overtime to obliterate my campaign. They have committed to spend whatever it takes to defeat me. They know if I win this race in Pennsylvania, it 'll be IMPOSSIBLE for Democrats to keep their majority in the Senate. If we don't show the Democrats we can win this race, it's game over. That's why I'm hoping you can spare Your donation will take us one step closer to victory, and I am so grateful for your support. Thank you, Dave McCormick P.S. subject: These barbaric war crimes must end now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
It’s not a “humanitarian crisis” it’s a genocide

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, As the nightmare in Gaza enters its second year, the violence is spiraling out of control with the Netanyahu regime accelerating its ethnic cleansing of the people of Gaza.

Many of us have seen the traumatic images of innocents screaming in horror as they were being burned alive in the targeting of Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital. Among the victims was young medical student, Shaban Ahmade Al-Dalu, who had written these haunting words just days before his murder: _“I have never in my life seen anything more terrifying than the thought of a person’s death, their disappearance in a single moment, their sudden escape... And the impossibility of their return. The human mind, with all its vivid imagination and capacity for understanding and creation, stands helpless before this absence. Were it not for God’s mercy upon us, for our faith that this is His decree and our acceptance of it, we would surely lose our sanity.”_
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_15_early_pm&n=1)
---
This young man had dreams of being a healer of the sick, only to have his dreams snatched away in the most horrific way imaginable.

Peter, we have borne witnesses to the most barbaric crimes against humanity in our lifetime - war crimes that could have been stopped by a single phone call from the Biden-Harris administration. Instead we’ve watched them send billions in aid, provide diplomatic cover for Israel, and peddle atrocity propaganda in service of allowing this carnage to continue.

We recently released a new ad aimed at letting voters know how to use the power of your vote to stop this genocide. Please watch now: [Your vote: real power for people, planet and peace _
_
**_We need to get this ad out to voters across the nation so that they know they have a choice to vote for the anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency ticket of Stein/Ware. We need you to donate today, at least $2.40, $24.00, or whatever you can give to get the word out everywhere in these crucial final weeks._**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/newad?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_15_early_pm&n=2)_
_

---
Last week, CNN allowed a rare moment of truth to slip through their propaganda when News Central anchor Kate Bolduan referred to the situation in Gaza as “a desperate humanitarian crisis” and was swiftly corrected by Dr. Tanya Haj-Hassan, an American intensive care physician who volunteered for two weeks at the now destroyed Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in the central Gaza strip: _“This is not a humanitarian crisis, Kate, and I’m going to say it very clearly for your viewers to hear:**this is genocide.”**_ To cast a vote for either Harris or Trump would be to forsake our own humanity and enable genocide. We cannot condone the killing of Shaban Ahmade Al-Dalu and what is likely hundreds of thousands of innocent souls taken from us in this genocide.

The power is in our hands: we must stop this now by voting for Jill Stein and Rudolph "Butch" Ware, the only candidates who will end these barbaric crimes against humanity on day one.

As Gaza goes, we all go. In solidarity and gratitude,
Team Stein/Ware 2024

The GOP nominee for President has always been racist. This is not a controversial statement. From his time [denying rental apartments to Black tenants](https://substack.com/redirect/1c93d3cf-bba8-4fa2-9395-44ff5f7c6e84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to his time [calling to execute five innocent Black and Latino youth](https://substack.com/redirect/5f0a977f-0785-4f9e-8730-76d1426a297c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to proudly [proclaiming](https://substack.com/redirect/350e17e1-5b96-498b-bc6c-d776a61c0fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "_Black guys counting my money! I hate it. The only kind of people I want counting my money are short guys that wear yarmulkes every day_ ," to his repeated condemnations of [Mexicans](https://substack.com/redirect/cf3a8f3d-639b-4408-ba79-0fb4e875b3aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Muslims](https://substack.com/redirect/5c47d3d5-d282-4541-a3b7-14d375ab0acb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/db0bf973-0554-4024-af29-4fd286ac68f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--racist is what Trump has always been. Now in clear cognitive decline, Donald Trump is leaning into that racism to rally his base. We cannot give him a pass as doing so further enables fascism to take hold of our democracy. **Let 's Address This**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cda24d73-ad38-4de8-a451-3a770afab4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

In these final days of the election season, Donald Trump believes his ticket to the White House is through demonization of minority communities. Most recently Donald Trump invoked a law from the 1700s--[one used to justify locking up hundreds of thousands of Americans of Japanese descent into concentration camps](https://substack.com/redirect/5b10f215-35ce-4444-933a-40eac15d98e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--to claim he would commit similar atrocities against immigrants if reelected. Trump wrote, "_To expedite removals of this savage gang, I will invoke the Alien Enemies Act of 1798 to target and dismantle ever migrant criminal network operating on American Soil_."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/746f7c79-e221-4095-846c-71eab2473fad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 1988, the US Congress formally apologized to Japanese Americans for the atrocities committed against them. Donald Trump well recalls that moment, because it was around that time that he was calling for the execution of the Central Park 5, despite their innocence. Perhaps most frightening is Trump's influence on the masses. FEMA reports that extremists, [inspired by Trump's disinformation surrounding Hurricane relief](https://substack.com/redirect/9327404c-9e15-4eb1-955d-e6a92cdd4196?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), prevented them from delivering aid under threat of violence. Trump of course claimed FEMA was out of money because it was spent on immigrants. [As I documented in detail, Trump is lying](https://substack.com/redirect/cd133fbf-aa14-4bfb-be03-c82b4961e785?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60d45cd0-a51f-48ec-aa48-653660021d46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8h6aOfFe29HwpETrmv3yISPrgpKW4yYEm_YlgSEJS3g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150267286)
In additional to his racism in general, antisemitism remains at the heart of Trump's hate. At an RNC boat parade in Jupiter, Florida just this week, actual Nazis proudly participated while screaming "White Power," "Hail Trump," and "Make America White Again." Donald Trump's own family participated in this same boat parade. The RNC, meanwhile, has not condemned these Nazis, nor disavowed them from the parade. I suppose conventional wisdom is it is unwise to condemn your Party nominees strongest supporters.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e0331666-390e-48b2-8272-b66a1ade8b1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meanwhile, Trump's cognitive decline has resulted in an unprecedented cancellation of public appearances, debates, and interviews. For the first time in half a century, a party nominee for President cancelled their 60 Minutes primetime interview.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e455679b-3b87-4e0e-bfda-e51cb4d2b508?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In a recent rally/town hall, Donald Trump took just five questions. He then inexplicably spent the next 30 minutes dancing to music by leaning back and forth. Surprising no one, the New York Times sane-washed his bizarre behavior as "it was more enjoyable." The continued failure of legacy media to hold Donald Trump accountable is one of the biggest threats to our democracy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d95ff858-db99-49ed-8936-0efe3e505414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump is even refusing friendly outlets. He's formally rejected a second debate against Kamala Harris, even though it would have been hosted by Fox News. Clearly, Trump's handlers realize they cannot allow him to face any form of meaningful scrutiny. And given how devastatingly he was manhandled at the first debate against Harris, he's perhaps choosing self-preservation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cdfda5c4-357f-4d82-ab51-9ca559021a54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Donald Trump has always, and exclusively, cared about Donald Trump. It is no surprise that he left thousands of followers stranded in the desert in California after a late night rally. This isn't a surprise to anyone not in the MAGA cult, but it is another example of what he would do should he re-enter the White House. That is, look out for himself and make decisions to benefit him and his family, not the American people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0dc6ea-5dc9-4d96-b9d9-7bb522ddb1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In the final weeks of the Presidential election, expect Trump to yet further lean into racism and fascism. His hope is to inspire his base to turn out in larger numbers, particularly in swing states, so he can ultimately lead the comprehensive implementation of Project 2025. We cannot let that happen. As I've written before, [Project 2025 is the end of democracy in America](https://substack.com/redirect/b8a2a4af-3662-4ada-8e85-6594c23bd190?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the unholy consecration of fascism. Legacy media continues to under react to Trump's extremism, and we are all worse off for it. Therefore, make sure you have a plan to vote, bring your friends with you, and let us defeat fascism on November 5. Then the real work begins to save our democracy and humanity.

**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! As we continue to track the most important events shaping battleground states, I’m Sabrina Niazi, and with my colleague Daniella Rodriguez, we’ll keep you informed on the key issues affecting our communities. This week, our focus is on Florida, where the devastating aftermath of Hurricane Milton is unfolding, impacting millions of lives.
---
| | | | **Florida**
---
|
---
Hurricane Milton made landfall on Florida’s Gulf Coast just days ago, bringing with it catastrophic winds, storm surges, and widespread flooding. The storm, now being described as one of the most powerful to hit Florida in recent history, has left significant damage in its wake. Homes have been destroyed, power lines are down, and millions are still without electricity. The economic toll is expected to be immense, with many Floridians facing a long road to recovery. President Biden has been quick to respond, coordinating federal relief efforts with FEMA and other agencies. He declared a state of emergency early on, ensuring that vital resources could be deployed to affected areas swiftly. This includes not only emergency shelters and medical aid but also financial assistance to help Floridians rebuild their homes and businesses. Biden has also been vocal about the urgent need to address the increasing frequency of such devastating storms, linking the severity of Hurricane Milton to the effects of climate change. In his latest address, the President reaffirmed his administration's commitment to helping Florida recover fully, emphasizing that no community will be left behind. His administration is also looking at long-term solutions to make coastal areas more resilient to future storms—a crucial issue as extreme weather events become more frequent. The response to Hurricane Milton is about more than just disaster relief—it’s about addressing the broader climate crisis that is making these storms stronger and more frequent. Florida, a key battleground state, has been on the front lines of climate change, and its voters are increasingly aware of the urgent need for action. As the 2024 election approaches, issues like climate resilience and disaster preparedness are becoming central themes for both state and national campaigns. For Democrats like Biden, ensuring an effective response to disasters like Hurricane Milton is essential not only for saving lives but also for demonstrating leadership in times of crisis. Florida’s recovery from this storm, both economically and socially, will play a significant role in shaping the political landscape in the months ahead. Stay tuned for our next update as we continue to bring you stories that matter. Stay informed with NDLB!
---
|
---
-Sabrina Niazi

---
MY BOLD, WIN-WIN PLAN
Our Agricultural Policy is Broken–
It Doesn’t Have to Be
Dear Peter,
America’s current agricultural policy is destroying our health, our land, and our family farms.
It’s squeezing small and mid-sized farmers out of business, while corporate giants thrive. Harmful chemicals pollute our soil and water, eventually making their way into our bodies.
And the USDA dietary guidelines? They’re skewed by corporate interests, _pushing ultra-processed foods that now make up 70% of the American diet_.
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
[Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_15_24_una1&n=5)
[**I’m ready to implement a bold, win-win plan with President Trump’s administration**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_15_24_una1&n=6) – a plan that puts family farmers, consumers, and our environment first. Here’s what I envision:
* **Empowering Farmers:** We’ll rewrite regulations to give family farmers a fair shot, level the playing field, and encourage sustainable practices that rebuild soil and replenish aquifers.
* **Banning Toxic Chemicals:** I’ll work to ban harmful agricultural chemicals already prohibited in other countries, so farmers can grow without poisoning our land, water, and bodies.
* **Fixing USDA Guidelines:** We’re going to restore integrity to dietary guidelines by removing conflicts of interest, ensuring Americans have access to natural, unprocessed foods.

I’ve seen what America’s innovative, regenerative farmers are already doing – greening deserts, revitalizing soils, and even replenishing water sources that have been dry for decades.
**Imagine if our government stopped fighting against these solutions and started embracing them.**
That’s the future I’m fighting for.

clean_body: We have 22 days to make this plan a reality, and we need every dollar for the final push. | | | | | | | MY BOLD, WIN-WIN PLAN Our Agricultural Policy is Broken– It Doesn’t Have to Be Dear Peter, America’s current agricultural policy is destroying our health, our land, and our family farms. It’s squeezing small and mid-sized farmers out of business, while corporate giants thrive. Harmful chemicals pollute our soil and water, eventually making their way into our bodies. And the USDA dietary guidelines? They’re skewed by corporate interests, pushing ultra-processed foods that now make up 70% of the American diet. But it doesn’t have to be this way. – a plan that puts family farmers, consumers, and our environment first. Here’s what I envision: Empowering Farmers: We’ll rewrite regulations to give family farmers a fair shot, level the playing field, and encourage sustainable practices that rebuild soil and replenish aquifers. Banning Toxic Chemicals: I’ll work to ban harmful agricultural chemicals already prohibited in other countries, so farmers can grow without poisoning our land, water, and bodies. Fixing USDA Guidelines: We’re going to restore integrity to dietary guidelines by removing conflicts of interest, ensuring Americans have access to natural, unprocessed foods. I’ve seen what America’s innovative, regenerative farmers are already doing – greening deserts, revitalizing soils, and even replenishing water sources that have been dry for decades. Imagine if our government stopped fighting against these solutions and started embracing them. That’s the future I’m fighting for. But time is running out. We have 22 days to make this plan a reality, and we need every dollar for the final push. As if you needed one: Here’s one more striking difference between this year’s two presidential candidates:
* Vice President Kamala Harris has released a credible, transparent update on her health and medical history.
* Donald Trump...._has not._

Why is that important? As a healthcare provider, I believe the American people deserve to have confidence in their elected officials’ mental and physical capacity to do the jobs they’ve elected them to do.

**[That’s why I’m sharing a call to other healthcare providers who agree. Are you a nurse, doctor, or medical student? Join our open letter demanding Trump release his medical records here:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRT8yKtlz1ux98EKPKg5PuQ5LczNz_u8UcKwei4G9Y9QyMcgS2oIpCdubcEHnmMjbRbORqe_-xXwMBBIcEd0KQnFOAVyJlZOdrQs_7PIyaXrVV99TFvz39aCJwr32lcMClkuxn1erzsmPB0sUigNCFddphBrWR-tjDz-lIZ4iMyByY8GLyQeQk1erGi-qCI_3j668TKNiS1Gy4JDuMRoP7n15L29qoL_4Eu3ih_6GlH6kDIpOWf9WxonsQJWkByDSGN7HThsqWjExzpZN62fyhZbcKtCL9XS0OrObR4WGgvPJdfDH9kGCnsTQX5XDsXiYh27mVUvxMx4H1xXihGiEOLGg/4am/vK0EZB5yRbe9mMan32eTQw/h1/h001.gsg2Yofa5zArNtXwcNLzxqDDXyZ91fGPx-nwBnVabUQ)** | | [Add my name to the letter](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRT8yKtlz1ux98EKPKg5PuQ5LczNz_u8UcKwei4G9Y9QyMcgS2oIpCdubcEHnmMjbRbORqe_-xXwMBBIcEd0KQnFOAVyJlZOdrQs_7PIyaXrVV99TFvz39aCJwr32lcMClkuxn1erzsmPB0sUigNCFddphBrWR-tjDz-lIZ4iMyByaycm5TO9X3EueaKx9A3W4eiHXYb6aAn4Y93NYb1qyWQfmrv5DKNMlRidLE-BLjaVmELdZN_31SVNs-TB_bbGAresryU6bWcdY_B6aI-D2zxVZ4rQSBYuV0fbdes4DzZcqNpM97QxgOUcWSIXM-JTGEElqr4ti4yFrPSXDAALC9HA/4am/vK0EZB5yRbe9mMan32eTQw/h2/h001.RXxypjB-UmmUHI7Jm-WIYa7IJsUuBKRwze7NBSSxHyU)

Trump is clearly displaying many concerning signs – we saw it during the first debate and we continue to see it at his rallies. Now, he’s backing out of widely broadcast interviews, like 60 Minutes, and refusing to attend a second debate.

The stakes of this election are higher than ever before. Vice President Harris has been transparent and confirmed her wellbeing and fitness to serve. Voters deserve to know that Trump is up to the job (at least physically).

subject: It’s not over in Arizona.

body:
We can’t say it any plainer than this — if we do not turn this around Arizona is going to slip through our fingers.
#

Peter, please.
Give us a minute to brief you on why Ruben Gallego’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona is worthy of your attention, and your support.
In what has consistently been one of the most contested, competitive, and expensive states in the country, we have been able to build a campaign that has what it takes to go the distance.
We can win in Arizona. We have a real shot and that is a credit to you, Peter, and your incredible support.
But in every single poll — every single one of them — anywhere from 5-10% of likely voters are still undecided. Still, even three weeks from the election.
That number keeps us up at night because it is more than enough to swing the race to Kari Lake. We are doing everything we can to reach those undecided voters. We’ve got a sound strategy. But that strategy is contingent on us hitting a series of fundraising goals — not arbitrary numbers, but concrete goals we need to hit to win this race.
We’ve been falling short of those goals. Day after day after day.
**We can’t say it any plainer than this — if we do not turn this around, Arizona is going to slip through our fingers. That means U.S. Senator Kari Lake. Some MAGA dude as Senate Majority Leader. And worst of all... President Donald Trump.**
We’re sorry to be so direct, but we’ve got to be brutally honest with you. This is serious.

Endorsement: Schultz promises stronger leadership for 8th District
Opinion by FCC Editorial Advisory Board October 12, 2024
Jen Schultz’s eight-year record of success in the Minnesota Legislature — helping everyday Minnesotans facing addiction, mental health challenges, difficulties affording their prescriptions, homelessness and more — is impressive on its own.
But consider, too, that before a career in public service, Schultz worked in the private sector, analyzing and improving access to health care and affordable medicines, working for a pharmaceutical company and as a consultant in health care, and offering input to Fortune 500 companies eager to provide the best health care plans they could at the best cost.
A professor of economics and co-director of the health care management program at the University of Minnesota Duluth, Schultz is making her second run to represent Minnesota’s 8th Congressional District. She’s the proven, responsive, constituents-focused choice for eligible voters in the massive district, which stretches more than halfway across the state’s northeast, from the Canadian border to the northern suburbs of the Twin Cities. The district includes the Iron Range, Duluth, Brainerd, Aitkin, all seven of Minnesota’s Anishinaabe reservations and more.
Perhaps nothing she did as a four-term legislator was bigger than the 2019 law to begin the state licensing of assisted-living facilities. Schultz helped carry the cause in the DFL House while Republican Sen. Karin Housley of Stillwater led the way in the Senate, producing a bill that created needed oversight and helped end years of horrific reports of abuse and inadequate care at far too many senior homes.
In a politically divided Legislature, Schultz, a DFLer, also worked behind the scenes and across the aisle to help pass a bipartisan omnibus bill that directed $700 million in federal relief for things like public health, drug abuse, mental health, homelessness, and public safety. Urgency demonstrated by Schultz and other lawmakers made Minnesota one of the first states to successfully allocate the federal funding.
She was also key in passing a bipartisan human services and policy bill that included investments to help those with mental health challenges and drug addictions. And she pushed for the passage of a bipartisan mental health standalone bill that included $100 million in badly needed spending.
“We’re at a point where we need to put our country and our democracy above our party. I’m going to be representing working families in the 8th District, older adults, people who rely on Social Security and Medicare,” Schultz said in an exclusive interview with Forum Communications this fall. “I have a track record of getting things done and solving big, big problems and helping working families.”
In D.C., that same hustle, effectiveness, and willingness to work with others, regardless of party, promises to benefit Minnesotans back home.
“The people in the 8th District deserve a better and stronger leader,” Schultz said.
Instead, they have Rep. Pete Stauber, who, for years now, has increasingly seemed more interested in furthering the political aspirations of his Republican Party and former President Donald Trump than in representing constituents.
In a statement this year — despite knowing better how criminal justice works due to his work as a Duluth police officer for 23 years — Stauber referred to the trial that found Trump guilty of duping banks and others in fraudulent business dealings as “rigged” and a “sham.” Perhaps even more disqualifying, Stauber signed on to the lawsuit that sought to overturn the will of the voters following the 2020 presidential election, making him part of the same coup that led to the violent and deadly Jan. 6, 2021, overrun of the U.S. Capitol.
Yes, Minnesota’s 8th Congressional District deserves better. In the Nov. 5 election, its voters can opt for a stronger, more-accessible leader in Schultz.

1️⃣ **Colorado remains one of the largest oil and gas producers in the nation.** With thousands of wells across the state, Colorado ranks as the fourth-largest oil-producing state in the U.S., contributing nearly 4% of the nation’s total crude output. County commissioners hold significant power over whether new drilling projects are approved or blocked, making these elections critical. Decisions made here will have an impact nationwide.

Let's win this, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

body:
Tonight, at 7pm, ABC will air a live interview with me...in what was supposed to be our only televised debate. Why? My opponent backed out. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=ed996791c6)
---
|
---
| | Peter, Tonight, at 7pm, ABC will air a live interview with me...in what was supposed to be the ONE televised debate of my Congressional race.

Why? My opponent backed out.

The debate was supposed to be live in the ABC studio tonight at 7pm. Both my campaign and hers had agreed to that date and time.

Then, I received an email from ABC letting me know that her campaign had a conflict and wanted to reschedule. Because I think that voters should learn as much as they can about candidates before they vote, I agreed to reschedule. The next email came as a shock.

My opponent refused to debate me on live TV.

The time is now to get our message out to voters. There is a stark difference between my positive message of solving the very real problems facing our country right now...and her consistently negative and false advertising.

Any amount you could send right now will help me to continue reaching voters with truth, hope, and solutions. If you don't like donating online, please consider mailing a check to Parrott for Congress, PO Box 32, Funkstown, MD 21734. **We have less than 3 weeks - If you are able, I earnestly ask you to please help now.** |

However, it is very possible that after my opponent's angry outbursts at the end of the Forum in Frederick last week, she doesn't want to risk talking through issues with me.

During the forum, she accused me of being divisive. I let it roll off, focusing on the issues. At the very end, she accused me again. So, in my closing statement, I pointed out that she has done nothing but attack me in her advertisements, saying nothing of her own record.

As I say in my commercial, "My opponent can't run on her record, so she's making up stories about mine." I must have struck a nerve, because her outburst was shocking. Even after I got up and walked away, she cupped her hands around her mouth and continued shouting at me.

I want to point out two things are this point which we should not lose sight of down the stretch: her schedule and third parties.

I support a woman’s fundamental right to make her own health care decisions about her own body. **Ted Cruz thinks he and other politicians should be able to make those decisions for you. But a doctor’s office is way too cramped when Ted Cruz is in the room with you.**
I support safeguarding our democracy, one that not only listens to the people, but also serves the people. **Cruz tried overturning the free and fair 2020 election.**
But here's the deal: Cruz and the deep-pocketed extremist super PACs propping up his campaign recently funneled $34 million into attack ads to crush the momentum behind our movement and defeat me.
**So with less than 21 days until Election Day, we absolutely must reach our $2 million goal before our final FEC public filing deadline – or we might not have enough resources to fight back against the GOP spending flooding into this race.**

Texans start voting next week. Early voting begins next Monday, October 21!
Visit VoteTexas.gov to learn more about early voting and find an early voting location near you. [http://votetexas.gov/] Then, make sure all the Texans you know have plans to cast their ballots between the start of early voting on Monday and Election Day on November 5. Share this link with them [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do] or simply forward this email!
With Texans about to start voting, #TeamLizzie has been out and about all over the district, visiting with volunteers who are making things happen here and talking with voters who will make the difference in this crucial election year.
How important is Texas? Well, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison’s visit to our HQ to support Colin Allred is a pretty good sign that Texas is in play. This team is essential to making it all happen. Read on for ways you can get involved.

Texas voters will have the opportunity to see two very different visions for Texas and two very different candidates. name: David Hogg
subject: This is how we save American democracy
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
The work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is essential, Peter
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241015&t=1&akid=1313%2E587540%2E17rG87)
Peter,
I won’t lie: Trump running neck-and-neck in the polls with Harris is disturbing. There are millions of people planning to vote again for a wannabe dictator.
But I have seen firsthand that our democracy is facing a bigger crisis than Trump. I think the biggest problem we’re facing in our political system is _hopelessness_.
**Hopelessness is exactly what empowered Trump to win in 2016.** And if we don’t address it now, it could help usher him into the White House again in November.
That’s why the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is so essential, Peter. By supporting young, bold progressives running for office across the country, we are giving the younger generations hope for the future — and a reason to vote.
**[We’ve got an important mid-month fundraising deadline coming up at MIDNIGHT and we need this team’s help to reach our $12,000 fundraising goal before the clock runs out. Chip in $5>>> ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241015?refcode=em20241015&amount=5&refcode2=1313_587540_17rG87&akid=1313%2E587540%2E17rG87)**
**Peter, the candidates we’re supporting — from Nate Douglas in Orlando, Florida to Anna Thomas in Pennsylvania — are the answer to hopelessness.**
Our candidates aren’t afraid to stand up and fight for our values on the issues that matter most to young people, like reducing gun violence, addressing the climate crisis with meaningful solutions, and defending the right to an abortion.
And they are doing more than just keeping the GOP at bay. They are charting **a path of progress** in our state legislatures and **building a bench** of young leaders who will undoubtedly make a mark on the national stage in the future. Think about this: **One of our candidates could very well be running for President one day!**
We are giving voters a reason to believe that participating in our elections is worth it when they see candidates who look and think like they do running for office, candidates who share their unique lived experiences and forward-thinking vision.
And we’re electing the next generation of leaders _everywhere_ , all across the country, because we know that no single person is coming to save us.
**Our representatives in the State House are just as important as who is in the White House.** We have to elect like-minded leaders at every level who will work with us to ensure a better future. And that’s why we’re so committed to this work.
I understand the concern for our democracy, but I am convinced that supporting progressive candidates from the younger generation is one of our best weapons in the fight to save it. **We can only defeat hopelessness with a reason for hope.**
**[Donate $5 or anything that makes sense for you now. I know we can hit this $12,000 fundraising goal by midnight with the support of this awesome team.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241015?refcode=em20241015&amount=5&refcode2=1313_587540_17rG87&akid=1313%2E587540%2E17rG87)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

name: Jazz Lewis
subject: October 2024 Newsletter
body:
https://www.jazzlewis.com/ [https://www.jazzlewis.com/]
October 2024 Newsletter
A Tour of Crownsville State Hospital
This past week, I had the opportunity to tour Crownsville State Hospital in Anne Arundel County. Established in 1911 as the Hospital for the Negro Insane, patients ranged from the mentally ill to the homeless to children with epilepsy or syphilis whose parents could not deal with the demands of their illness, particularly during the Great Depression.
Historians have educated the public about the hospital’s grisly conditions and notorious mistreatment of patients, including medical experimentation without consent. This complicated past is not unique to Crownsville, and is a grim reminder that systematic oppression was widespread and can continue to disproportionately affect our most vulnerable populations if we are not vigilant.
I’m grateful to Delegate Heather Bagnall (District 33C, Anne Arundel County) and Anne Arundel County Executive Steuart Pittman for hosting me and supporting the preservation of Crownsville and the dignity of those who suffered there. I commend their work and thank Delegate Bagnall, particularly, for her tireless efforts advocating for the site, mental health issues, and mental health care throughout our state.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Crownsville%20State%20Hospital%201.jpg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Crownsville%20State%20Hospital%202.jpg]
Maryland League of Conservation Voters Score
I’m proud to announce that the Maryland League of Conservation Voters has again given me a 100% environment score! The recent hurricanes in the South are a stark reminder that humankind plays an undeniable role in climate change and that stronger protections are needed to ensure a safe future for District 24, Prince George’s, and all of Maryland. I will continue to prioritize protecting our beautiful district and state by voting “yes” on issues promoting environmental safety and equity regardless of zip code. I’m committed to tackling the climate crisis and protecting Maryland's environment, and I’m honored to have your support for these efforts. Let’s keep District 24 beautiful!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/LCV%20Environment%20Score.png]
Prince George’s Proud!
Prince George’s County has a LOT to be proud of this year, including our county executive, Angela Alsobrooks, who is nearing the finish line in her campaign for the U.S. Senate! I have complete confidence in Angela and know she is the most qualified candidate to succeed Senator Ben Cardin and represent Maryland. But first, we need to make sure we vote on or before November 5 and help her win this race.
To keep the momentum going, Congressman Steny Hoyer, Councilman Calvin Hawkins, and I are hosting a phone bank on October 23 at 5:00-7:30 PM in Upper Marlboro to support Angela’s campaign and make sure we keep the Senate blue! If you can join us, click here [https://mobilize.us/s/fREoCC] or visit https://mobilize.us/s/fREoCC [https://mobilize.us/s/fREoCC] to sign up.
If you can’t make it to our phone bank, consider posting an Alsobrooks sign in your yard or window. Click here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSduhPktmsU2E8gS5m-tBTTpuO_bLOqCV4wfRdi6mfY5fAaCgA/viewform] to request yours!
bit.ly/JazzOct22 [bit.ly/JazzOct22]
Sukkot 2024
Wishing a Happy Holiday to all who are observing Sukkot this week!

Hey team,

In a moment, I’m going to [**ask you to split a small donation between my campaign and Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54685?t=7&akid=22307%2E4449941%2E8K97Q1) But first, I wanted to explain why your gift is so important – especially right now.

From the moment I jumped into the race for U.S. Senate, Republicans piled on with attacks and insults.

It actually started the night right before I announced my campaign. In one of Kevin McCarthy’s first acts as Speaker (remember him?), he unilaterally removed me from serving on the House Intelligence Committee.

Then Anna Paulina Luna and the GOP caucus bowed to Trump’s demands and voted to censure me in a partisan act of retribution.

And Donald Trump has kept piling on. Again and again and again. He just can’t resist attacking “Shifty Schiff” and making false claims about his impeachment and what he calls the “Russia hoax.”

Republican campaign organizations use my name in their fundraising appeals to rile up their MAGA base.

This doesn’t even include the really crazy stuff.

**Republicans see me as their boogeyman this election. Why? Because I’ve stood up to these bullies and called out their lies.**

Imagine how upset Trump will be to see me in the Senate. He and his enablers don’t want oversight. They don’t want me to hold them accountable. They don’t want an outspoken defender of democracy on the Senate floor.

Bad news for Republicans: I’ve never been one to give up a fight — especially when it gets tough. I’m not going to let Donald Trump or any one of his lackeys tear our campaign down. [**In this final stretch of the election, I need to know you have my back. Will you pitch in a split donation of $10 or any amount today between my campaign and Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54685?t=8&akid=22307%2E4449941%2E8K97Q1) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54686?t=9&akid=22307%2E4449941%2E8K97Q1)

BCJ: Pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101524_2&amount=25]
Team: We've repeatedly highlighted a key fact: That the landmark John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement has been stuck in the U.S. House of Representatives. Supporters of voting rights from Joe Biden to Kamala Harris to Stacey Abrams have called on Congress to act. It's up to all of us to help to get this critical bill moving again.
After ten long years of attacks on voting rights, from the 2013 Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder to the voter suppression bills that swept over our country since the 2020 election, this legislation is a ray of light beaming out from a dark landscape.
This bill would undo the damage done by the Supreme Court and create a Voting Rights Act for the 21st century. It would restore preclearance in states that are discriminating on the basis of race and create preclearance for certain practices that are frequently discriminatory. It would also bolster Section 2 of the original Voting Rights Act, which allows lawsuits to ensure voters of color have the opportunity for fair representation. I n short, this bill would right a lot of wrongs in our democracy.
Team: We need to answer the call to fight for this bill ASAP. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass this critical legislation >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101524_2&amount=25]

The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the Supreme Court dismantling it piece by piece, we need the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore our right to vote.
The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice has called the current assault on voting rights "staggering" . According to their accounting, " At least 19 states passed 33 laws in 2021 making it harder to vote. Many of these laws target voters of color, exacerbating persistent racial disparities in access. Turnout for nonwhite voters is now substantially lower than that for white voters — and has been for at least 25 years. Despite record voter turnout in 2020, only 58 percent of nonwhite voters participated, compared to 71 percent of white voters. "
Congress has the power to solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.

Peter,
When you’re a Green Beret on the battlefields of Afghanistan, you have to make a lot of life-or-death judgments.

When I think of my time in combat, I remember the moments I didn’t think I’d make it. I was pushed to my limit physically and mentally. _But every time, I came out the other side._

You learn a lot of hard truths when you’re fighting in the desert, but I’ve realized that it’s not just combat soldiers who need these lessons.

**Everyone can benefit from the wisdom of Green Berets, and that’s why I wrote my new book _Hard Truths_.**

Now, YOU can harness the same power as our Green Berets to help you conquer the everyday challenges you face in your life.

Green Beret principles teach conflict resolution and emphasize the importance of discipline and self-control.

In **_Hard Truths_** , I lay out a path to understanding and developing the resilience, trust, and restraint that are essential to setting a game plan to help you face challenges and win your own battles.

Friend, This spring, State Rep. Munira Abdullahi was supporting Ohio State University students protesting genocide when police officers grabbed her hijab (headscarf) and pushed her to the ground, arresting peaceful students nearby. She condemned the police violence and the violations of our rights, explaining: _“The freedom of speech and the right to peacefully assemble are the basic fundamental freedoms guaranteed to us in the 1st amendment.”_ **The first Muslim woman and first Somali American to serve in Ohio’s State Legislature, Munira is standing up for our rights and pushing back against rising bigotry** —including the targeting of women and girls who wear hijabs. Last week in my city of Detroit, a 7 year-old Yemeni girl who wears a hijab experienced a horrific attack when a man slit her throat. She is alive but traumatized, and so many of our neighbors are living in fear because lawmakers and media outlets keep spreading racist, Islamophobic hate. **In this time of increasing dehumanization, we need more people in public office who respect the shared humanity of all of their constituents, and who champion policies to save lives at home and abroad.** Ohio State Rep. Munira Abdullahi understands that we all deserve safety and human dignity. **A Type-1 diabetic who’s experienced overwhelming medical costs, Munira has introduced legislation to cap the price of insulin** —as well as gun safety policies and bills to protect workers’ rights. She helped secure wins like $30 million for affordable housing, despite serving in a Republican-controlled state government. This is what valuing life looks like. Munira Abdullahi was supporting Ohio State University students protesting genocide when police officers grabbed her hijab (headscarf) and pushed her to the ground, arresting peaceful students nearby. | Deaton Debates the Issues, Warren Focuses on Demonizing Republicans
---
---
| Boston, MA- During tonight's Senate debate, Elizabeth Warren showed once again that she has no real answers for the challenges facing Massachusetts voters. When pressed on the ongoing border crisis, Warren dodged the question entirely, shifting blame onto former President Donald Trump instead of presenting a path forward or coming to account for her vote rejecting a bipartisan border bill.
"John Deaton came ready to debate on policy and issues affecting Massachusetts, while Elizabeth Warren relied on the same tired progressive talking points and attacks on Republicans," said MassGOP Chair, Amy Carnevale. "She provided no solutions for the border crisis or any new direction for our state and nation."
Throughout the debate, Warren continued her pattern of partisan politics, choosing to demonize Republicans rather than engage in meaningful policy discussions. Despite serving in Congress for over 12 years, Warren has only successfully passed one piece of legislation--a record that underscores her inability to deliver real results for Massachusetts families.
"Elizabeth Warren is a creature of D.C. partisanship tearing this country apart. She has become the ultimate partisan hack, using scare tactics instead of offering real leadership," said Carnevale. "There's a reason she's avoiding five debates--her one-note performance can't hold up over time."
John Deaton represents a refreshing alternative to Warren's divisive politics. If elected, Deaton will work across the aisle to bring common-sense solutions to Washington.
"Whether you're a Republican or a moderate independent, Warren made it clear tonight: she sees you as an enemy to demonize, not a voter to represent," added Carnevale.
With Warren out of step and focused on attacks, Massachusetts voters have an opportunity to elect a new leader. John Deaton is ready to bring fresh ideas and bipartisan solutions to the Senate.

subject: Important Ohio Update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We’re fighting for voter choice in Ohio

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, We have an important update on Ohio – our hearing is scheduled for tomorrow and we believe it will be a slam dunk!

In case you missed it, someone not authorized to submit paperwork on behalf of the campaign turned in a document requesting to withdraw the Vice Presidential candidate from the ballot, after the deadline to submit a new candidate.

The person who submitted this paperwork to the Ohio Secretary of State admitted when turning in the form that the signature on the form was not “wet” (it was a graphic that was copy and pasted), and that they were not a campaign staffer. The Secretary of State should have rejected it on those grounds alone. But instead, they accepted the form - then declared no votes for Jill would count. To make this even more incredible and unacceptable, our Ohio VP candidate then sent the SoS a notarized affidavit stating that she didn’t authorize the withdrawal form, and the SoS replied that they wouldn’t accept it because the notarization wasn’t “embossed”... after they had accepted the original, unauthorized VP withdrawal form with a copy-pasted signature from a person who had no standing to submit it! **_We are confident that we will prevail in our lawsuit tomorrow and votes for Jill will be counted in Ohio._** These fights against shenanigans in multiple states have been a huge expense for the campaign, but it is worth it to ensure that the people, including the 8 million registered voters in Ohio, have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action candidate on their ballots in November. _[**Peter, can you please pitch in today to make sure that Jill and Butch can get their empowering message out to voters everywhere in these crucial final weeks?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/newad?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_ohio_10_15_pm&n=1)

"**Gov. Greg Abbott boasted that Texas removed 6,500 noncitizens from its voter rolls -- that number was likely inflated,** " Texas Tribune / ProPublica's **Lexi Churchill** and **Vianna Davila** , Texas Tribune's **James Barragan** and Votebeat's **Natalie Contreras** -- "In late August, with a hotly contested presidential election less than three months away, Texas Gov.**Greg Abbott** [boasted that the state had removed](https://substack.com/redirect/cb702226-1198-4a7b-853f-80bd435319e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 1 million ineligible voters from its rolls, including more than 6,500 noncitizens.

The Republican governor said the Texas secretary of state's office was turning over nearly 2,000 of those characterized as noncitizens to Attorney General **Ken Paxton** for investigation because records showed they had a voting history.

"Illegal voting in Texas will never be tolerated," Abbott said in a press release.

The former registered voters whom Abbott called noncitizens, and the other people removed from the rolls since September 2021, were taken off through a routine practice local election officials conduct that includes culling the names of people who have moved or died. Election experts have urged caution in using the numbers to make definitive statements about registered noncitizens.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/084aa20d-270d-49c1-800b-418d61eba78f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But Abbott did just that, initially stating in his news release that thousands of noncitizens had been stripped from the rolls.

His office then edited the press release after publication, softening it by adding the word "potential" before noncitizens.

Abbott's claims helped to fan ongoing unsubstantiated Republican allegations that noncitizens plan to cast ballots en masse to sway elections for Democrats, assertions that former President **Donald Trump** and his party are using to cast doubt on the integrity of the upcoming November election.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70yr](https://substack.com/redirect/084aa20d-270d-49c1-800b-418d61eba78f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
An investigation by ProPublica, The Texas Tribune and Votebeat, however, found that the governor's claims about noncitizens on the rolls appear inflated and, in some cases, wrong.

The secretary of state's office identified 581 people, not 6,500, as noncitizens, according to a report it gave Abbott in late August that the newsrooms obtained through a public information request.

In response to questions about the basis for Abbott's larger number, the secretary of state's office told the news organizations that it had "verbally" provided the governor's office with a separate number of people removed from the rolls who failed to respond to letters alerting them that there were questions about their citizenship.

The governor's news release combined the two figures.

That means U.S. citizens who simply never received or responded to such letters are almost certainly included in Abbott's 6,500 number. Abbott did not respond to requests for comment, and Secretary of State **Jane Nelson** declined to be interviewed." Greg Abbott boasted that Texas removed 6,500 noncitizens from its voter rolls -- that number was likely inflated, " Texas Tribune / ProPublica's Lexi Churchill and Vianna Davila , Texas Tribune's James Barragan and Votebeat's Natalie Contreras -- "In late August, with a hotly contested presidential election less than three months away, Texas Gov.Greg Abbott more than 1 million ineligible voters from its rolls, including more than 6,500 noncitizens. The Republican governor said the Texas secretary of state's office was turning over nearly 2,000 of those characterized as noncitizens to Attorney General Ken Paxton for investigation because records showed they had a voting history. "Illegal voting in Texas will never be tolerated," Abbott said in a press release. The former registered voters whom Abbott called noncitizens, and the other people removed from the rolls since September 2021, were taken off through a routine practice local election officials conduct that includes culling the names of people who have moved or died. Election experts have urged caution in using the numbers to make definitive statements about registered noncitizens. But Abbott did just that, initially stating in his news release that thousands of noncitizens had been stripped from the rolls. His office then edited the press release after publication, softening it by adding the word "potential" before noncitizens. Abbott's claims helped to fan ongoing unsubstantiated Republican allegations that noncitizens plan to cast ballots en masse to sway elections for Democrats, assertions that former President Donald Trump and his party are using to cast doubt on the integrity of the upcoming November election. An investigation by ProPublica, The Texas Tribune and Votebeat, however, found that the governor's claims about noncitizens on the rolls appear inflated and, in some cases, wrong. The secretary of state's office identified 581 people, not 6,500, as noncitizens, according to a report it gave Abbott in late August that the newsrooms obtained through a public information request. In response to questions about the basis for Abbott's larger number, the secretary of state's office told the news organizations that it had "verbally" provided the governor's office with a separate number of people removed from the rolls who failed to respond to letters alerting them that there were questions about their citizenship. The governor's news release combined the two figures. That means U.S. citizens who simply never received or responded to such letters are almost certainly included in Abbott's 6,500 number. Abbott did not respond to requests for comment, and Secretary of State Jane Nelson declined to be interviewed." Greg Abbott boasted that Texas removed 6,500 noncitizens from its voter rolls -- that number was likely inflated,** " Texas Tribune / ProPublica's **Lexi Churchill** and **Vianna Davila** , Texas Tribune's **James Barragan** and Votebeat's **Natalie Contreras** -- "In late August, with a hotly contested presidential election less than three months away, Texas Gov.**Greg Abbott** [boasted that the state had removed](https://substack.com/redirect/71018161-caa1-4f33-a143-baf5d878d375?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 1 million ineligible voters from its rolls, including more than 6,500 noncitizens.

The Republican governor said the Texas secretary of state's office was turning over nearly 2,000 of those characterized as noncitizens to Attorney General **Ken Paxton** for investigation because records showed they had a voting history.

"Illegal voting in Texas will never be tolerated," Abbott said in a press release.

The former registered voters whom Abbott called noncitizens, and the other people removed from the rolls since September 2021, were taken off through a routine practice local election officials conduct that includes culling the names of people who have moved or died. Election experts have urged caution in using the numbers to make definitive statements about registered noncitizens.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/356325d0-2ce1-4036-8979-b1da27515c40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But Abbott did just that, initially stating in his news release that thousands of noncitizens had been stripped from the rolls.

His office then edited the press release after publication, softening it by adding the word "potential" before noncitizens.

Abbott's claims helped to fan ongoing unsubstantiated Republican allegations that noncitizens plan to cast ballots en masse to sway elections for Democrats, assertions that former President **Donald Trump** and his party are using to cast doubt on the integrity of the upcoming November election.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/356325d0-2ce1-4036-8979-b1da27515c40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
An investigation by ProPublica, The Texas Tribune and Votebeat, however, found that the governor's claims about noncitizens on the rolls appear inflated and, in some cases, wrong.

The secretary of state's office identified 581 people, not 6,500, as noncitizens, according to a report it gave Abbott in late August that the newsrooms obtained through a public information request.

In response to questions about the basis for Abbott's larger number, the secretary of state's office told the news organizations that it had "verbally" provided the governor's office with a separate number of people removed from the rolls who failed to respond to letters alerting them that there were questions about their citizenship.

The governor's news release combined the two figures.

That means U.S. citizens who simply never received or responded to such letters are almost certainly included in Abbott's 6,500 number. Abbott did not respond to requests for comment, and Secretary of State **Jane Nelson** declined to be interviewed." [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e377a0-8d1f-4ca1-9f40-2cdc2224884c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Colin Allred is running for election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**consider splitting a donation between Colin's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-allred.-4YRZz&refcode=em241015-1-90&t=1&akid=5898%2E6688874%2E5h8KCs)

Friend, later today I’ll be stepping onto the stage to debate Ted Cruz for the first time. I have been waiting for this moment since my campaign began.
I know exactly how his actions – and inactions – have hurt not just Texans, but every American.
**From his trip to Cancun during a deadly winter freeze to being responsible for Texas' abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest or health of the mother, Ted Cruz can run, but he can’t hide from his extreme record.
[**Before I take the debate stage tonight, will you show that you'll be standing with me by chipping in a split donation of $3 or anything you can between me and Mark Kelly to make sure that we have what it will take to defeat Cruz on November 5th?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-allred.-4YRZz&refcode=em241015-1-90&t=2&akid=5898%2E6688874%2E5h8KCs)

body:
Today marks just three weeks until Election Day and this is still anyone’s race. I’m reaching out one last time before the final FEC deadline ahead of Election Day, team.

Today marks just three weeks until November 5 and this is still anyone’s race. The latest public poll shows Mike Lawler is leading by just a single point. Lawler and his allies aren’t slowing down their spending—or attacks—so we can’t take our foot off the gas either.

| Peter,

My journey, like that of so many Latino families, is rooted in hard work and sacrifice. Nothing represents the resilience of the Hispanic community more than my first-gen parents, an industrial mechanic and an elementary school teacher, who fought to ensure that all 7 of their children received a quality higher education.

**Their perseverance drives my passion for fighting for working families just like mine in Congress.**
* Last year, I became the **first woman to lead BOLD PAC** , and with that responsibility comes a mission–to elevate Latino voices in leadership and ensure our communities are represented in Washington
* This year, the **Ways and Means Committee selected me as the first Latina to serve as ranking member** of the Subcommittee on Oversight

**Hispanic Heritage Month may be coming to a close today, but our commitment to uplifting our communities continues. We need leaders who will continue to champion our values and protect the progress we’ve made.**

Peter, I’m about to take the debate stage with my opponent to discuss the issues that matter most to Pennsylvanians.

subject: Who is Jim Jordan really fighting for?
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
The ULTRA-MAGA world loves to say Jim Jordan is a fighter.
But my question is: a fighter for who?
He’s definitely not fighting for Ohioans – because after 17 years in Congress, he has never authored a bill that’s passed.
And he’s certainly not fighting for Americans.
How could he be when he aided and abetted the January 6th seditionists who tried to overthrow our government?
Most importantly, Jim Jordan is not fighting for those who need it most.
When Jordan was an assistant wrestling coach at the Ohio State University, he didn’t even fight for his own wrestlers when they were being serially sexually abused.
Make no mistake, Jim Jordan knew what was happening, but he looked the other way instead of standing up for those young men.
When they came forward seeking justice, Jordan didn’t fight for them.
He ran like a selfish coward!
That’s why we’re fighting to end his career. Will you contribute $25, $50, or $100 today to help us reach more voters and expose the truth about Jim Jordan? We’ve got him on the ropes, but we need every bit of support to take this campaign across the finish line. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241015_no_fighter_link1]
You would think that now since he is the Chair of the Judiciary Committee and he loves to launch investigations ALL THE TIME he would launch an investigation about the sexual abuse scandal that happened on his watch, but he doesn’t. I mean seriously, If you were innocent and promised parents you would look after their child, wouldn’t you DO SOMETHING?
I WOULD! I AM!
He claims he didn’t know the abuse was happening, but all the wrestlers say otherwise, even the Head Coach.
In fact, one of them testified that Jordan called them crying asking them not to testify against him and not to reveal too much!
To this day, he’s never admitted it, and he hasn’t even asked how they are doing.
I’ve never known anyone to be in the middle of everything but not know anything about anything.
Let’s get real for a second: If it walks like a duck, quacks like a duck – you know the rest.
Jim Jordan is acting guilty because he has something to hide.
We deserve the truth. We deserve a representative who genuinely fights for us, not for their twisted agenda.
It’s clear Jordan is more interested in covering for himself and protecting his ULTRA-MAGA buddies than doing his job.
This is the most important congressional race in the country. Jordan is on the run, and we can’t let up now. He’s nervous, and he should be. We’re coming for him, and we’re going to win. Rush a donation right now to be part of the team that kicks a gross abuse enabler out of Congress for good. Tamie Wilson

subject: It’s really close, Derek:
body:
All the data we have points to 2024 being one of the closest elections in history.
---
Derek, You’ve probably been hearing some version of this a lot recently: **_The election is going to be extraordinarily close, and the result could come down to just a few thousand votes in key battleground states._** **And it’s true.** This election is going to be close. [**That’s why we’re asking if you can make your first $15 contribution of this election cycle to the Democratic National Committee. We could really use help from folks pitching in for the first time at this defining moment in the race.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?amount=15&refcode=em_20241015_1867_fr&refcode2=1867_22930333_0qw475&akid=1867%2E22930333%2E0qw475) All the data we have points to 2024 being one of the closest elections in history. If this makes you nervous, you’re not alone. There is a very real chance we could be staring down a second Donald Trump presidency and Republican control of Congress. **But there’s another truth about an election this close: it means every single thing YOU can do between now and Election Day will have a tremendous impact.** Every grassroots donation, every door knock, and every phone call helps us reach another undecided voter -- it helps get one more person off the couch and into a voting booth to vote for Democrats up and down the ballot. In an election that could be decided by a few thousand votes in a few states, that could be the difference between winning and losing. Between president-elect Kamala Harris and a second Trump presidency with no guardrails. [**So Derek, if you were waiting for a reason to make your first contribution to the Democratic Party, here it is: You may never make a more impactful donation in your life. This is it.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?amount=15&refcode=em_20241015_1867_fr&refcode2=1867_22930333_0qw475&akid=1867%2E22930333%2E0qw475) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $15](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=15&refcode=em_20241015_1867_fr&refcode2=1867_22930333_0qw475&akid=1867%2E22930333%2E0qw475)**

| | Friends,

I am running for reelection to the King County Council because I am the last line of defense fighting against an extremist Seattle agenda that is making our communities less safe and less affordable. I am working hard every day to bring commonsense back to King County.

Today, I am excited to announce a major update in my race for the King County Council: **All Nine Mayors Representing the Citizens of District 9 have endorsed my reelection campaign!**

This is a big deal! The unanimous and bipartisan endorsements of all Mayors representing the citizens of Council District 9 demonstrate that our message of fiscal responsibility, support for local businesses and workers, and commonsense policies that make our communities safer, like keeping open the juvenile detention center, is extremely popular. **Would you be willing to add your name to my endorsement list as well?**
**_[ENDORSE MY CAMPAIGN HERE](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=a7ca1dd01e&e=77eef70c61)._**
Earning the support of the Mayors of Bellevue, Renton, Maple Valley, Enumclaw, Covington, Black Diamond, Kent, Newcastle, and Issaquah is a massive achievement, and I am incredible grateful by the outpouring of local support for our campaign.

In this final stretch of the 2024 campaign season, if you would be willing to support my campaign for reelection by **_[endorsing my campaign](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=8a5c33fb6a&e=77eef70c61)_** , or **[donating $15, $25, or $50](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=04bd75511c&e=77eef70c61), **I would be honored!

Reagan Dunn ReaganDunn.com
